a: Hatam tenan "aval lo et haotzar", veamar shemuel: may "aval lo et haotzar" — aval lo yigmor et haotzar kullo, dilma ate leashvoye gummot. hacha may?
Hatam hu beshabbat deasur — mishshum dachamir, aval yom tov dekil — shappir dame. o dilma: hatam deikka bittul bet hammidrash — amrat la, hacha delekka bittul bet hammidrash — lo kol shekken.

Vehacha tenan: mashshilin perot derech arubba beyom tov, veamar rav nachman: lo shanu ella beoto haggag, aval miggag legag — la. vetanya name hachi: en metaltelin miggag legag afillu kesheggaggotehen shavin.
Hatam may? (kol shekken shabbat dachamira, o dilma:) hacha hu deasur — mishshum yom tov dekil, veate lezalzole beh, aval shabbat dachamira, vela ate lezalzole ba — shappir dame.
O dilma: ma hacha deikka hefsed perot — amrat la, hatam delekka hefsed perot — lo kol shekken.

Hacha (tenan): lo yeshalshelem bechevel bechallonot, velo yoridem derech sullamot, hatam may? hacha beyom tov hu deasur — delekka bittul bet hammidrash, aval shabbat, deikka bittul bet hammidrash — shappir dame.
O dilma: hacha deikka hefsed perot — amrat la, hatam delekka hefsed perot — lo kol shekken. teku.
Umechassin et happerot. amar ulla: vaafillu avvera delivne. rabbi yitzchak amar: perot haruyin. veazda rabbi yitzchak letameh. deamar rabbi yitzchak: en keli nittal ella ledavar hannittal beshabbat.
Tenan: mechassin et happerot bechelim. perot — in, avvera delivne — la! hu haddin daafillu avvera delivne, veayyeyde ditna resha mashshilin perot — tena sefa name mechassin et happerot.
Tenan: vechen kadde yayin vechen kadde shemen! hacha bemay askinan, betivla.
Hachi name mistabbera, dei salka datach kadde yayin vechadde shemen dehettera, ha tena leh resha perot?
Kadde yayin vechadde shemen itztericha leh, salka datach amena: lehefsed merubbe — chashshu, lehefsed muat — lo chashshu, ka mashma lan.
Tenan: notnin keli tachat haddelef beshabbat. bedelef harauy.
Ta shema: porsin machtzelet al gabbe levenim beshabbat! deiyyaytur mibbinyana, dachaze lemizge alayyhu.
Ta shema: porsin machtzelet al gabbe avanim beshabbat! baavanim mekurezalot, dechazyayn levet hakkisse.
Ta shema: porsin machtzelet al gabbe kavveret devorim beshabbat, bachamma — mippene hachamma, uvaggeshamim — mippene haggeshamim, uvilvad shello yitkavven latzud! hatam name, deikka devash.

Amar leh rav ukeva mimmeshan lerav ashe: hatinach bimot hachamma, deikka devash. bimot haggeshamim, may ikka lememar? lo nitzrecha ella leotan shete challot. otan shete challot muketzot hen! hacha bemay askinan — shechishshev alehem.
Aval lo chishshev alehem may — asur? addetane uvilvad shello yitkavven latzud, liflog velitne bedida: bamme devarim amurim — shechishshev alehen, aval lo chishshev alehem — asur!
Hachi kaamar: af al pi shechishshev alehen — uvilvad shello yitkavven latzud.
Bemay okemta — kerabbi yehuda, deit leh muketze? ema sefa: uvilvad shello yitkavven latzud — atan lerabbi shimon, deamar: davar sheen mitkavven muttar!
Vetisbera derabbi shimon? veha abbaye verava deamri tarvayyhu: mode rabbi shimon bifsik resheh vela yemut!
Leolam kulla rabbi yehuda hi, vehacha bemay askinan — deit beh kavve. vela tema lerabbi yehuda, uvilvad shello yitkavven latzud,
b: Ella ema: uvilvad shello yaasenna metzuda. peshita! mahu detema: bemino nitztzod — asur, shello bemino nitztzod — muttar, ka mashma lan.

Rav ashe amar: mi katane bimot hachamma uvimot haggeshamim? bachamma mippene hachamma uvaggeshamim mippene haggeshamim katane — beyome nisan uveyome tishre, deikka chamma, veikka geshamim, veikka devash.
Venotnin keli tachat haddelef beshabbat. tana: im nitmalle hakkeli — shofech veshone, veeno nimna.
Be richya deabbaye deluf. ata lekammeh derabba, amar leh: zil ayyeyleh lefureyach lehatam, deleheve kigraf shel rei, veappekeh.
Yatev abbaye veka kashya leh: vechi osin geraf shel rei lechattechilla? addehachi nefal be richya deabbaye. amar: tete li daavari addemar.
Amar shemuel: geraf shel rei veavit shel meme raglayim — muttar lehotzian laashpa, ucheshehu machziro — noten bo mayim umachziro.
Sevur minna: geraf shel rei, aggav mana — in, bifne atzmo — la. ta shema: dehahu achbarta deishtechach be isparmake derav ashe. amar lehu rav ashe: niktu betzutzite veappeku.
Mishna kol shechayyayvin alav mishshum shevut, mishshum reshut, mishshum mitzva, beshabbat — chayyayvin alav beyom tov.
Veellu hen mishshum shevut: lo olin bailan, velo rochvin al gabbe behema, velo shatin al pene hammayim, velo metappechin velo mesappekin velo merakkedin.
Veellu hen mishshum reshut: lo danin, velo mekaddeshin, velo choltzin, velo meyabbemin.
Veellu hen mishshum mitzva: lo makdishin, velo maarichin, velo macharimin, velo magbihin teruma umaaser.
Kol ellu beyom tov amru, kal vachomer bashshabbat. en ben yom tov lashshabbat ella ochel nefesh bilvad.
Gemara lo olin bailan — gezera shemma yitlosh.
Velo rochvin al gabbe behema — gezera shemma yetze chutz lattechum. shema minna techumin deorayyta! ella: gezera shemma yachtoch zemora.
Velo shatin al pene hammayim — gezera shemma yaase chavit shel shayyaytin.
Velo metappechin velo mesappekin velo merakkedin — gezera shemma yetakken kele shir.
Veellu hen mishshum reshut: lo danin. veha mitzva kaaved! la tzericha, deikka daadif minneh.
Velo mekaddeshin. veha mitzva kaaved! la tzericha,

a: Deit leh ishsha uvanim.
Lo choltzin velo meyabbemin. veha mitzva ka aved! la tzericha, deikka gadol, umitzva baggadol leyabbem.
Vechullehu tama may — gezera shemma yichtov.
Veellu hen mishshum mitzva: lo makdishin velo maarichin velo macharimin — gezera mishshum mikkach umimkar.
Velo magbihin terumot umaasrot. peshita! tane rav yosef: lo nitzrecha ella littenah lechohen bo bayyom.
Vehane mille pere ditvili meetmol, aval pere ditvili haiddana, kegon issa leafroshe minna challa — mafreshinan veyahavinan lechohen.
Vehane, mishshum reshut ikka, mishshum shevut lekka? vehane, mishshum mitzva ikka, mishshum shevut lekka?
Amar rabbi yitzchak, la mibbaya kaamar: la mibbaya shevut geredta deasur, ella afillu shevut dirshut name asur. vela mibbaya shevut dirshut deasur, ella afillu shevut demitzva name asur.
Kol ellu beyom tov amru, ureminhu: mashshilin derech arubba beyom tov, aval lo beshabbat!
Amar rav yosef, la kashya: ha rabbi eliezer, ha rabbi yehoshua.
Detanya: oto veet beno shennaflu levor — rabbi eliezer omer: maale et harishon al menat leshochto veshochato, vehashsheni ose lo parnasa bimkomo kede shello yamut.
Rabbi yehoshua omer: maale et harishon al menat leshochto veeno shochato, vechozer umaarim umaale hashsheni. ratza — ze shochet, ratza — ze shochet.
Amar leh abbaye: mimmay? dilma ad kan la kaamar rabbi eliezer hatam, ella deefshar befarnasa, aval hacha dela efshar befarnasa — la!
I name: ad kan la kaamar rabbi yehoshua hatam, ella deefshar leaarome. aval hacha dela efshar leaarome — la.
Ella amar rav pappa, la kashya: ha bet shammay, ha bet hillel.
Ditnan, bet shammay omrim: en motziin lo et hakkatan velo et hallulav velo et sefer tora lirshut harabbim, uvet hillel mattirin.
Dilma la hi, ad kan la ka amri bet shammay hatam, ella ahotzaa, aval attiltul — la. attu tiltul lav tzorech hotzaa hu?
Mishna habbehema vehakkelim keragle habbealim. hammoser behemto livno o laroe — hare ellu keragle habbealim.
Kelim hameyuchadin leechad min haachin shebbabbayit — hare ellu keraglav. vesheen meyuchadin — hare ellu kimkom sheholchin.

Hashshoel keli mechavero meerev yom tov — keragle hashshoel. beyom tov — keragle hammashil. vechen haishsha sheshshaala mechavertah tavlin umayim vamelach leissatah — hare ellu keragle shetehen. rabbi yehuda poter bammayim, mippene sheen bahen mammash.
Gemara matnitin
b: Dela kerabbi dosa, detanya: rabbi dosa omer, veamri la: abba shaul omer, hallokeach behema mechavero meerev yom tov, af al pi shello mesarah lo ella beyom tov — hare hi keragle hallokeach. vehammoser behema laroe, af al pi shello mesarah lo ella beyom tov — hare hi keragle haroe.
Afillu tema rabbi dosa, vela kashya: kan beroe echad, kan bishne roim. dayka name dekatane: livno o laroe, shema minna.
Amar rabba bar bar chana amar rabbi yochanan: halacha kerabbi dosa. umi amar rabbi yochanan hachi? vehaamar rabbi yochanan: halacha kistam mishna, utenan: habbehema vehakkelim keragle habbealim!
Velav okemna — kan beroe echad, kan bishne roim!

Tanu rabbanan: shenayim sheshshaalu chaluk echad beshuttafut, ze lelech bo shacharit levet hammidrash, veze likkanes bo arvit levet hammishte. ze erav alav latztzafon, veze erav alav laddarom. ze sheerav alav latztzafon — mehallech latztzafon keragle mi sheerav alav laddarom.
Vaze sheerav alav laddarom — mehallech laddarom keragle mi sheerav alav latztzafon.
Veim mitztzeu et hattechum — hare ze lo yezizenna mimmekomah.
Ittemar: shenayim shellakchu chavit uvehema beshuttafut, rav amar: chavit mutteret uvehema asura. ushemuel amar: chavit name asura.
May kasavar rav? i ka savar yesh berera — afillu behema tishtere! vei kasavar en berera — afillu chavit name asura!
Leolam kasavar yesh berera, veshanya behema — deka yanki techumin mehadade. amri leh rav kahana verav assi lerav: leissur muketze lo chashshu, leissur techumin chashshu?! shatek rav.
May have ala? rabbi hoshaya amar: yesh berera. verabbi yochanan amar: en berera.

Vesavar rabbi hoshaya yesh berera? vehatnan: hammet bevayit, velo petachim harebe — kullan temeim. niftach echad mehen — hu tame, vechullan tehorim. chishshev lehotzio beechad mehen, o bachallon sheyyesh bo arbaa al arbaa — matztzelet al happetachim kullan.
Bet shammay omrim: vehu shechishshev alav ad shello yamut hammet. uvet hillel omrim: af mishsheyyamut hammet.
Veittemar ala, amar rabbi hoshaya: letaher et happetachim mikkan ulehabba. mikkan ulehabba — in, lemafrea — la.
Efoch, rabbi hoshaya amar: en berera, verabbi yochanan amar: yesh berera.
Umi it leh lerabbi yochanan berera? vehaamar rav assi amar rabbi yochanan: haachin shechalku — lakochot hen, umachzirin ze laze bayyovel.
Vechi tema: ki let leh lerabbi yochanan berera — bidorayyta, aval bidrabbanan — it leh,
Uvidrabbanan mi it leh? vehatane ayyo —
Rabbi yehuda omer: en adam matne al shene devarim keechad, ella: im ba chacham lammizrach — eruvo lammizrach, lammaarav — eruvo lammaarav, veillu lechan ulechan — la.

a: Vehavenan ba: may shena lechan ulechan dela — deen berera, mizrach umaarav name en berera!
Veamar rabbi yochanan: uchevar ba chacham. alma: let leh lerabbi yochanan berera!
Ella: leolam la tefoch, vechi let leh lerabbi oshaya berera — bidorayyta, aval bidrabbanan — it leh.
Daresh mar zutera: halacha kerabbi oshaya.
Amar shemuel: shor shel pattam — hare hu keragle kol adam. shor shel roe — hare hu keragle otah hair.
Hashshoel keli mechavero meerev yom tov. peshita! la tzericha, shello mesaro lo ella beyom tov. mahu detema: lav birshuteh okmeh, ka mashma lan.
Mesayyay leh lerabbi yochanan, deamar rabbi yochanan: hashshoel keli mechavero meerev yom tov, af al pi shello netano lo ella beyom tov — hare hu keragle hashshoel.
Beyom tov — keragle hammashil. peshita! la tzericha, dirgil veshael minneh, mahu detema: birshuteh ka mokem leh, ka mashma lan, memar amar: dilma mashkach inish acharina veazel veshael minneh.

Vechen haishsha sheshshaala mechavertah. ki selek rabbi abba amar: yehe raava deema milleta detitkabbal. ki selek, ashkecheh lerabbi yochanan verabbi chanina bar pappi verabbi zera, veamri la rabbi avahu verabbi shimon ben pazzi verabbi yitzchak nappacha, veyatvi vekaamri: ammay? velivtil mayim vamelach legabbe issa! amar lehu rabbi abba:
b: Hare shennitarev lo kav chittin baasara kabbin chittin shel chavero, yochal halla vechade?! achichu aleh. amar lehu: gulletaychu shekali? hadur achichu aleh.

Amar rav oshaya: shappir avud deachichu aleh. may shena chittin bisorim dela kaamar lehu — dehave leh min besheeno mino, umin besheeno mino — batel. chittin bechittin name, nehi dilrabbi yehuda lo batel, lerabbanan mivtal batel.
Amar leh rav safra: moshe! shappir kaamrat?! vela shemia lehu ha deamar rabbi chiyyay ketosfaa mishshemeh derav: habborer tzerorot miggorno shel chavero — chayyayv leshallem lo deme chittim.
Alma: kayla chassereh. hacha name — kayla chassereh.
Amar leh abbaye: vela shane leh lemar ben mamon sheyyesh lo tovin lemamon sheen lo tovin?
Amar leh: velitamaych, ha deamar rav chisda: nevela betela bishchuta, lefi shei efshar lashshechuta shettease nevela.
Shechuta enah betela binvela, lefi sheefshar lannevela shettease shechuta.

Hachi name dechi it la bealim — la batla? vechi tema hachi name — veha tanya, amar rabbi yochanan ben nuri: cheftze hefker konin shevita. af al pi sheen lahem bealim — domin kemi sheyyesh lahem bealim.
Amar leh: mi ka medammet issura lemamona? issura — batel, mamona — lo batel.
Vetama may?
Abbaye amar: gezera shemma taase issa beshuttafut.
Rava amar: tavlin letama avidi, vetama la batel.

a: Verav ashe amar: mishshum dehave leh davar sheyyesh lo mattirin, vechol davar sheyyesh lo mattirin — afillu beelef lo batel.
Rabbi yehuda poter bammayim. mayim in, melach la? veha tanya, rabbi yehuda omer: mayim vamelach betelin ben baissa ben bakkedera! la kashya: ha — bemelach sedomit, ha — bemelach isterokanit.
Vehatanya, rabbi yehuda omer: mayim vamelach betelin baissa, veen betelin bakkedera mippene rotbah! la kashya: ha — beava, ha — berakka.

Mishna haggachelet keragle habbealim, veshalhevet bechol makom. gachelet shel hekdesh — moalin bah, veshalhevet — lo nehenin, velo moalin. hammotzi gachelet lirshut harabbim — chayyayv, veshalhevet — patur.

Gemara tanu rabbanan: chamishsha devarim neemru baggachelet: haggachelet keragle habbealim, veshalhevet bechol makom. gachelet shel hekdesh — moalin bah, veshalhevet — lo nehenin velo moalin. gachelet shel avoda zara — asura, veshalhevet — mutteret. hammotzi gachelet lirshut harabbim — chayyayv, veshalhevet — patur. hammuddar hanaa mechavero — asur begachalto, umuttar beshalhavto.

May shena shalhevet avoda zara desharya, umay shena dehekdesh daasira? avoda zara, dimisa uvedili inashe minna — la gezaru ba rabbanan. hekdesh, dela meis vela bedili inashe minneh — gezaru beh rabbanan.
Hammotzi gachelet lirshut harabbim — chayyayv, veshalhevet — patur. veha tanya: hammotzi shalhevet kol shehu — chayyayv! amar rav sheshet: kegon shehotzio bekesam.
Vetippok leh mishshum kesam! bidlet leh shiura. ditnan: hammotzi etzim — kede levashshel betza kalla.
Abbaye amar: kegon deshayyfeh [l]mana mishcha veatli beh nura. vetippok leh mishshum mana? bechaspa.
Vetippok leh mishshum chaspa! bidlet leh shiura. ditnan: cheres — kede litten ben patztzim lachavero, divre rabbi yehuda.
Ella ha ditnan: hammotzi shalhevet patur, hechi mashkachat la? kegon deaddeyeh addoye lirshut harabbim.
Mishna bor shel yachid — keragle hayyachid, veshel anshe otah hair — keragle anshe otah hair, veshel ole vavel — keragle hamemalle.

Gemara rame leh rava lerav nachman, tenan: bor shel yachid — keragle hayyachid, ureminhu: neharot hammoshchin umaayanot hannovin — hare hen keragle kol adam! amar (rava): hacha bemay askinan — bimchunnasin. veittemar name, amar rabbi chiyyay bar avin amar shemuel: bimchunnasin.
Veshel ole vavel — keragle hamemalle. ittemar: mille venatan lachavero, rav nachman amar: keragle mi shennitmalleu lo, rav sheshet amar: keragle hamemalle.
Bemay ka mippalgi? mar savar: bera dehefkera hu, umar savar: bera deshuttafe hu.
Etiveh rava lerav nachman: hareni alecha cherem — hammuddar asur.
b: Hare atta alay cherem — hannoder asur. hareni alecha veatta alay — shenehem asurim ze baze, umuttarin beshel ole vavel, vaasurin beshel otah hair.
Veellu hen devarim shel ole vavel: har habbayit, halleshachot vehaazarot, uvor shel emtza hadderech. veellu hen shel otah hair: harchov, uvet hakkeneset, uvet hammerchatz.
Vei amrat bera deshuttafe hu, ammay muttar? vehatnan: hashshuttafin shennadru hanaa ze mizze — asurim likkanes lechatzer lirchotz babbor!
Lirchotz hachi name, vehacha bemay askinan — lemalloot, mar middideh ka memalle umar middideh ka memalle.
Vesavar rav nachman yesh berera? vehatnan: haachin hashshuttafin, keshechayyayvin bakkalbon — peturin mimmasar behema.
Ucheshechayyayvin bemasar behema — peturin min hakkalbon.
Veamar rav anan: lo shanu ella shechalku gedayim keneged telaim utelaim keneged gedayim.
Aval chalku gedayim keneged gedayim utelaim keneged telaim, omer: zehu chelko hammaggio mishshaa rishona lechach.
Verav nachman amar: afillu chalku gedayim keneged gedayim utelaim keneged telaim — en omer: ze chelko hammaggio mishshaa rishona lechach.
Ella dechulle alma bera dehefkera hi, ella hacha bemagbiah metzia lachavero ka mippalgi. mar savar: kana, umar savar: la kana.
Mishna mi shehayu perotav beir acheret veervu bene otah hair lehavi etzlo mipperotav — lo yaviu lo. veim erav hu — perotav kamohu.

a: Mi shezzimmen etzlo orchim — lo yolichu beyadam manot, ella im ken zikka lahem manotehem meerev yom tov.

Gemara ittemar: hammafkid perot etzel chavero — rav amar: keragle mi shehifkidu lo, ushemuel amar: keragle hammafkid. lema rav ushemuel deazdu letamayyhu, ditnan: im hichnis birshut — baal hechatzer chayyayv. rabbi omer: leolam eno chayyayv ad sheyyekabbel alav baal habbayit lishmor.
Veamar rav huna amar rav: halacha kedivre chachamim, ushemuel amar: halacha kerabbi. lema rav deamar kerabbanan ushemuel deamar kerabbi?
Amar lecha rav: ana daamari afillu lerabbi — ad kan la kaamar rabbi hatam, ella devistama la kabbel aleh netiruta, aval hacha — ha kabbel aleh netiruta.

Ushemuel amar: ana daamari afillu lerabbanan — ad kan la kaamri rabbanan hatam, ella denicha leh leinish denekum toreh birshuteh devaal chatzer, dei mazzek leh — la michayyayv. aval hacha — mi nicha leh leinish delekum pereh birshuteh dechavreh?!
Tenan: veim erav hu — perotav kamohu. vei amrat keragle mi shehifkidu etzlo, ki erav hu may have? amar rav huna, amri be rav: kegon sheyyiched lo keren zavit.

Ta shema: mi shezzimmen etzlo orchim — lo yolichu beyadam manot, ella im ken zikka lahem manotehem meerev yom tov. vei amrat keragle mi shehifkido etzlo, ki zikka lahem al yede acher may have? hachi name, kevan shezzikka lahem al yede acher — kemi sheyyiched lo keren zavit dame.
Veibbaet ema: zikka shane.
Rav chana bar chanilay tela bisra beivra dedashsha. ata lekammeh derav huna, amar leh: i at telet — zil shekel, vei inhu telo lach — la tishkol.
Vei ihu tela mi shakel? veha rav huna talmid derav hava, veamar rav: keragle mi shehifkidu etzlo! shane ivra dedasha, dichmi sheyyiched lo keren zavit dame.
Amar leh rav hillel lerav ashe: vei inhu talu leh la shakel? vehaamar shemuel: shor shel pattam — hare hu keragle kol adam.

Amar leh ravina lerav ashe: vei inhu talu leh la shakel? vehaamar rabba bar bar chana amar rabbi yochanan: halacha kerabbi dosa. amar leh rav ashe lerav kahana: vei inhu talu leh la shakel? vehatnan: habbehema vehakkelim keragle habbealim!

Ella, shane rav chana bar chanilay — degavra rabba hu uterid bishmateh, vehachi kaamar leh: i at telet, it lach simana begavvevy vela massechat datach minneh, zil shekol. vei inhu talu lach, massechat datach, vela tishkol.
Mishna en mashkin veshochatin et hammidbariyyot, aval mashkin veshochatin et habbayyaytot. ellu hen bayyaytot — hallanot bair. midbariyyot — hallanot baafar.
Gemara lema li lememar mashkin veshochatin? milleta aggav orcheh ka mashma lan, delashke inash behemto vahadar lishchot, mishshum sircha demashka.

Tanu rabbanan: ellu hen midbariyyot veellu hen bayyaytot. midbariyyot — kol sheyyotzot bappesach veroot baafar, venichnasot birvia rishona. veellu hen bayyaytot — kol sheyyotzot veroot chutz lattechum, uvaot velanot betoch hattechum. rabbi omer: ellu veellu bayyaytot hen. ella ellu hen midbariyyot  — kol sheyyotzot veroot baafar, veen nichnasot layyishshuv, lo bimot hachamma velo bimot haggeshamim.
Umi it leh lerabbi muketze? veha bea minneh rabbi shimon bar rabbi merabbi: patzile temara — lerabbi shimon mahu? amar leh: en muketze lerabbi shimon
b: Ella gerogrot vetzimmukin bilvad!
Ibbaet ema: hane name kigrogrot vetzimmukin dame, veibbaet ema: lidvarav derabbi shimon kaamar, veleh la sevira leh.

Veibbaet ema: ledivrehem derabbanan kaamar lehu. ledidi en muketze, ella ledidchu: odo li mihat hecha deyotzot veroot bappesach venichnasot birvia rishona devayyaytot hen. vaamaru leh rabbanan: la, midbariyyot hen.
Hadaran alach mashshilin perot uselika massechet betza

a: Arbaa rashe shanim hem, beechad benisan — rosh hashshana lammelachim velargalim.
Beechad beelul — rosh hashshana lemasar behema. rabbi elazar verabbi shimon omrim: beechad betishri.
Beechad betishri — rosh hashshana lashshanim velashshemittin velayyovlot, lintia velirakot.
Beechad bishvat — rosh hashshana lailan kedivre bet shammay. bet hillel omrim: bachamishsha asar bo.
Gemara lammelachim, lemay hilcheta? amar rav chisda: lishtarot.
Ditnan: shitre chov hammukedamin — pesulin, vehameucharin — kesherin.
Tanu rabbanan: melech sheamad beesrim vetisha baadar, kevan shehiggia echad benisan — alta lo shana. veim lo amad ella beechad benisan — en monin lo shana ad sheyyaggia nisan acher.
Amar mar: melech sheamad beesrim vetisha baadar, kevan shehiggia echad benisan — alta lo shana. ha
b: Ka mashma lan denisan rosh hashshana limlachim, veyom echad bashshana chashuv shana. veim lo amad ella beechad benisan, en monin lo shana ad sheyyaggia nisan acher. peshita!
La tzericha, deimmeno aleh meadar. mahu detema, nimno leh tarten shenin, ka mashma lan.

Tanu rabbanan: met baadar veamad acher tachtav baadar — monin shana leze velaze. met benisan veamad acher tachtav benisan — monin shana leze velaze. met baadar veamad acher tachtav benisan — monin rishona larishon, usheniyya lashsheni.
Amar mar: met baadar veamad acher tachtav baadar — monin shana leze velaze. peshita! mahu detema: shatta leve tere la maninan, ka mashma lan.

Met benisan veamad acher tachtav benisan — monin shana leze velaze. peshita! mahu detema: ki amrinan yom echad bashshana chashuv shana — besof shana. aval bitchillat shana — la amrinan, ka mashma lan.

Met baadar veamad acher tachtav benisan — monin rishona larishon usheniyya lashsheni. peshita! la tzericha, deimmeno aleh meadar, umelech ben melech hu, mahu detema: nimno leh tarten shenin, ka mashma lan.

Amar rabbi yochanan: minnayin lammelachim sheen monin lahem ella minnisan — shenneemar: "vayhi vishmonim shana vearba meot shana letzet bene yisrael meeretz mitzrayim bashshana harviit bechodesh ziv hu hachodesh hashsheni limloch shelomo al yisrael". makkish malchut shelomo litziat mitzrayim: ma yetziat mitzrayim minnisan — af malchut shelomo minnisan.
Vitziat mitzrayim gufa menalan deminnisan maninan? dilma mittishri maninan!

La salka datach, dichtiv: "vayyaal aharon hakkohen el hor hahar al pi Adonai vayyamot sham bishnat haarbaim letzet bene yisrael meeretz mitzrayim bachodesh hachamishi beechad lachodesh", uchetiv: "vayhi bearbaim shana beashte asar chodesh beechad lachodesh dibber moshe vegomer". middekae beav vekare la "shenat arbaim", vekae bishvat vekare la "shenat arbaim" — mikkelal derosh hashshana lav tishre hu.
Bishlama hayech — mefaresh delitziat mitzrayim, ella hay, mimmay delitziat mitzrayim, dilma lahakamat hammishkan?
Kidamar rav pappa: "shenat esrim" "shenat esrim" — ligzera shava, hacha name: "shenat arbaim" "shenat arbaim" — ligzera shava: ma kan litziat mitzrayim — af kan litziat mitzrayim.
Umimmay demaase deav kadem, dilma maase dishvat kadem!
La salka datach, dichtiv: "achare hakkoto et sichon", vechi nach nafsheh deaharon akkatti hava sichon kayyaym, dichtiv:

a: "Vayyishma hakkenaani melech arad", ma shemua shama? shama shemmet aharon, venistalleku anne kavod, uchesavur nittena reshut lehillachem beyisrael. vehayeynu dichtiv: "vayyiru kol haeda ki gava aharon",
Veamar rabbi avahu: al tikre "vayyiru", ella "vayyirau", kidresh lakish. deamar resh lakish, "ki" meshammesh bearba leshonot: i, dilma, ella, deha.

Mi dame? hatam kenaan, hacha sichon! tana: hu sichon, hu arad, hu kenaan. sichon — sheddome lisyaych bammidbar, kenaan — al shem malchuto, uma shemo — arad shemo. ikka deamri: arad — sheddome learod bammidbar, kenaan — al shem malchuto, uma shemo — sichon shemo.
Veema rosh hashshana iyyayr!

La salka datach, dichtiv: "vayhi bachodesh harishon bashshana hashshenit beechad lachodesh hukam hammishkan", uchetiv: "vayhi bashshana hashshenit bachodesh hashsheni naala heanan meal mishkan haedut", middekae benisan vekare la "shana shenit", vekae beiyyayr vekare la "shana shenit" — mikkelal derosh hashshana lav iyyayr hu!

Veema rosh hashshana sivan? la salka datach, dichtiv: "bachodesh hashshelishi letzet bene yisrael meeretz mitzrayim", veim ita — "bachodesh hashshelishi bashshana hashshenit letzet vegomer" mibbee leh!
Veema tammuz! veema av! veema adar!
Ella amar rabbi elazar, mehacha: "vayyachel livnot bachodesh hashsheni bashsheni bishnat arba lemalchuto". may "sheni"? lav sheni leyerach shemmonin bo lemalchuto?!
Matkef la ravina: veema sheni bachodesh! im ken, "sheni bachodesh" behedya hava ketiv beh.
Veema besheni bashshabbat! chada, dela ashkechan sheni bashshabbat dichtiv. veod: makkish sheni batra lesheni kamma: ma sheni kamma — chodesh, af sheni batra — chodesh.

Tanya kevoteh derabbi yochanan: minnayin sheen monin lahem lammelachim ella minnisan, shenneemar: "vayhi vishmonim shana vearba meot shana letzet bene yisrael meeretz mitzrayim vegomer", uchetiv: "vayyaal aharon hakkohen el hor hahar al pi Adonai vegomer", uchetiv: "vayhi bearbaim shana beashte asar chodesh".

Uchetiv: "achare hakkoto et sichon vegomer", veomer: "vayyishma hakkenaani vegomer", veomer: "vayyiru kol haeda ki gava aharon vegomer", veomer: "vayhi bachodesh harishon bashshana hashshenit vegomer".
Veomer: "vayhi bashshana hashshenit bachodesh hashsheni vegomer", veomer: "bachodesh hashshelishi letzet bene yisrael vegomer", veomer: "vayyachel livnot vegomer".

Amar rav chisda: lo shanu ella lemalche yisrael, aval lemalche ummot haolam — mittishri maninan, "shenneemar: "divre nechemya ben chachalya vayhi vechodesh kislev shenat esrim vegomer", uchetiv: "vayhi bechodesh nisan shenat esrim leartachshaste vegomer".
Middekae bechislev vekare leh "shenat esrim", vekae benisan vekare leh "shenat esrim" — mikkelal derosh hashshana lav nisan hu.
Bishlama hayech — mefaresh dilartachshaste, ella hay — mimmay dilartachshaste? dilma
b: Leminyana acharina hu? amar rav pappa: "shenat esrim" "shenat esrim" — ligzera shava: ma hatam leartachshaste, af hacha leartachshaste.
Umimmay demaase dechislev kadem, dilma maase denisan kadem?
La salka datach, detanya: devarim sheamar chanani linchemya bechislev, amaran nechemya lammelech benisan.

Devarim sheamar chanani linchemya bechislev — shenneemar: "divre nechemya ben chachalya vayhi vechodesh kislev shenat esrim vaani hayiti beshushan habbira. vayyavo chanani echad meachay hu vaanashim mihuda vaeshalem al hayyehudim happeleta asher nisharu min hashshevi veal yerushalam. vayyomru li hannisharim asher nisharu min hashshevi sham bammedina beraa gedola uvecherpa vechomat yerushalam meforatzet usheareha nitztzetu vaesh".

Amaran nechemya lammelech benisan, shenneemar: "vayhi bechodesh nisan shenat esrim leartachshaste hammelech yayin lefanav vaessa et hayyayin vaettena lammelech velo hayiti ra lefanav. vayyomer li hammelech maddua panecha raim veatta encha chole en ze ki im roa lev vaira harebe meod. vaomar lammelech hammelech leolam yichye maddua lo yeru fanay asher hair bet kivrot avotay chareva usheareha ukkelu vaesh".

"Vayyomer li hammelech al ma ze atta mevakkesh vaetpallel el elohe hashshamayim. vaomar lammelech im al hammelech tov veim yitav avdecha lefanecha asher tishlacheni el yehuda el ir kivrot avotay veevnenna. vayyomer li hammelech vehashshegal yoshevet etzlo ad matay yihye mahalachcha umatay tashuv vayyitav lifne hammelech vayyishlacheni vaettena lo zeman".

Metiv rav yosef: "beyom esrim vearbaa lachodesh bashshishshi bishnat shetayim ledaryavesh", uchetiv: "bashshevii bishnat shetayim beesrim veechad lachodesh". veim ita — "bashshevii bishnat shalosh" mibbee leh!
Amar rabbi avahu: koresh melech kasher haya, lefichach manu lo kemalche yisrael.

Matkef la rav yosef: chada — deim ken kashu kerae ahadade, dichtiv: "veshetzi bayta dena ad yom telata lirach adar di hi shenat shet lemalchut daryavesh malka", vetanya: beoto zeman lashshana habbaa ala ezra mibbavel vegaluto immo, uchetiv: "vayyavo yerushalam bachodesh hachamishi hi shenat hashsheviit lammelech", veim ita — "shenat hashsheminit" mibbee leh.
Veod: mi dame? hatam koresh, hacha daryavesh! tana: hu koresh, hu daryavesh, hu artachshaste. koresh — shemmelech kasher haya, artachshaste — al shem malchuto, uma shemo — daryavesh shemo.
Mikkol makom kashya! amar rabbi yitzchak, la kashya: kan kodem shehechmitz, kan leachar shehechmitz.
Matkef la rav kahana: umi hechmitz? vehachtiv:

a: "Uma chashchan uvene torin vedichrin veimmerin laalavan leelah shemayya chintin melach chamar umeshach kememar kahanayya di virushelem leheve mityehev lehom yom beyom di la shalu"! amar lo rabbi yitzchak: rabbi, mittunach: "di lehevon mehakervin nichochin leelah shemayya umetzallayin lechayye malka uvenohi".
Uman deaved hachi lav mealleyuta hi? vehatanya, haomer: "sela zo litzdaka bishvil sheyyichyu banay", uvishvil sheezke bah lechayye haolam habba" — hare ze tzaddik gamur.
La kashya: kan beyisrael, kan begoyim.
Veibbaet ema: menalan deachmitz — dichtiv: "nidbachin di even gelal telata venidbach di a chadat venifketa min bet malka tityehiv", lema leh daavad hachi? savar: i mardu bi yehudae — ikleyeh benura.

Attu shelomo la avad hachi? vehachtiv: "shelosha ture gazit vetur kerutot arazim"! shelomo avad millemala, veihu avad millematta. shelomo shakkeeh bevinyana, ihu la shakkeeh bevinyana. shelomo sadyeh besida, ihu la sadyeh besida.
Amar rav yosef, veittema rabbi yitzchak: menalan deachmitz — mehacha: "vayyomer li hammelech vehashshegal yoshevet etzlo". may "shegal"? amar rabba bar lima mishshemeh derav: kalbeta.

Ella meatta, ha dichtiv: "veal mare shemayya hitromamta ulemanayyay di vayteh hayetiv kodamach veant veravrevanach sheglatach ulechenatach chamra shatayin behon", vei "shegal" kalbeta hi, kalbeta bat mishteya chamra hi? ha la kashya, demallefa la veshatyay.

Ella meatta dichtiv: "benot melachim beyikkerotecha nitztzeva shegal limincha bechetem ofir", vei shegal kalbeta hi, may ka mevassar lehu navi leyisrael?! hachi kaamar: bischar shechaviva tora leyisrael keshegal laggoyim — zechitem lechetem ofir.
Veibbaet ema: leolam "shegal" — malketa hi, verabba bar lima gemara, gemir la. veammay kare la "shegal"? shehayta chaviva alav keshegal. i name: shehoshivah bimkom shegal.

Veibbaet ema: menalan deachmitz — mehacha: "ad kesaf kakkerin mea vead chintin korin mea vead chamar battin mea vead battin meshach mea umelach di la chetav vegomer". meikkara — bela kitztzuta, vehasheta — bekitztzuta.
Vedilma meikkara la hava kim leh bekitztzuta? ella, mechavvavrta kidshanniyn meikkara.
Velargalim. regalim beechad benisan hu? bachamishsha asar benisan hu! amar rav chisda: regel shebbo, rosh hashshana largalim.
Nafka minna lenoder, lemekam aleh beval teacher", verabbi shimon hi. detanya: echad hannoder, veechad hammakdish, veechad hammaarich, kevan sheavru alav shelosha regalim — over beval teacher".

Rabbi shimon omer: shelosha regalim kesidran, vechag hammatztzot techilla. vechen haya rabbi shimon ben yochay omer: regalim, peamim shelosha, peamim arbaa, peamim chamishsha. ketzad? nadar lifne happesach — shelosha. lifne atzeret — chamishsha. lifne hechag — arbaa.
Tanu rabbanan: chayyayve haddamin vehaarachin, hacharamin vehahekdeshot, chattaot vaashamot, olot ushelamim, tzedakot umaasrot, bechor umaaser ufesach,
b: Leket shichcha ufea, kevan sheavru alehen shelosha regalim — over beval teacher". rabbi shimon omer: shelosha regalim kesidran, vechag hammatztzot techilla.

Rabbi meir omer: kevan sheavar alehen regel echad — over beval teacher". rabbi eliezer ben yaakov omer: kevan sheavru alehen shene regalim — over beval teacher". rabbi elazar berabbi shimon omer: kevan sheavar alehen chag hassukkot — over alehen beval teacher".
May tama detanna kamma — mikkede minnayyhu salek, lema li lemehdar umichtav: "bechag hammatztzot uvechag hashshavuot uvechag hassukkot"? shema minna leval teacher".
Verabbi shimon omer: eno tzarich lomar "bechag hassukkot", shebbo dibber hakkatuv, lamma neemar — lomar shezze acharon.
Verabbi meir — may tama? dichtiv: "uvata shamma ... vahavetem shamma".
Verabbanan — hahu laase.
Verabbi meir, kevan deamar leh rachamana ayyti vela ayyti — mimmela kam leh beval teacher".
Verabbi eliezer ben yaakov, may tama? dichtiv: "elle taasu laAdonai bemoadechem" — miut moadim shenayim.
Verabbanan — hahu lechidrabbi yona. deamar rabbi yona: hukeshu kol hammoadim kullam ze laze, shekkullan mechapperim al tumeat mikdash vekadashav.
Verabbi elazar berabbi shimon, may tama? detanya, rabbi elazar berabbi shimon omer: lo yeamer "chag hassukkot", shebbo dibber hakkatuv, lamma neemar — lomar shezze gorem.

Verabbi meir verabbi eliezer ben yaakov: hay "bechag hammatztzot uvechag hashshavuot uvechag hassukkot" may darshu beh? mibbee lehu lechidrabbi elazar amar rabbi oshaya. deamar rabbi elazar amar rabbi oshaya: minnayin laatzeret sheyyesh lah tashlumin kol shiva? talmud lomar: "bechag hammatztzot uvechag hashshavuot uvechag hassukkot", makkish chag hashshavuot lechag hammatztzot: ma chag hammatztzot yesh lo tashlumin kol shiva — af chag hashshavuot yesh lo tashlumin kol shiva.
Velaykkish lechag hassukkot: ma lehallan shemona — af kan shemona! shemini regel bifne atzmo hu.
Emor deamrinan shemini regel bifne atzmo leinyan pazer kashev, aval leinyayn tashlumin — divre hakkol tashlumin derishon hu!
Ditnan: mi shello chag yom tov harishon shel chag — chogeg et kol haregel veyom tov haacharon shel chag.
Tafasta merubbe — lo tafasta, tafasta muat — tafasta.
Ella lemay hilcheta katveh rachamana lechag hassukkot? leakkosheh lechag hammatztzot:

a: Ma chag hammatztzot taun lina — af chag hassukkot taun lina.
Vehatam menalan? dichtiv: "ufanita vabboker vehalachta leohalecha".
Vetanna kamma verabbi shimon (ben elazar) — tashlumin laatzeret mena lehu?
Nafka lehu middetane rabba bar shemuel. detane rabba bar shemuel: amra tora mene yamim vekaddesh chodesh, mene yamim vekaddesh atzeret. ma chodesh limnuyav — af atzeret limnuyav.
Ema atzeret chad yoma? amar rava: attu atzeret yome maninan, shavue la maninan? vehaamar mar: mitzva lemimne yome, umitzva lemimne shavue. veod: "chag shavuot" ketiv.
Ufesach bar mikrav birgalim hu? pesach zimna kevia leh, i akreveh — akreveh, vei la akreveh — iddechi leh!
Amar rav chisda: pesach kedi nasve.
Rav sheshet amar: may "pesach" — shalme fesach.
I hachi — hayeynu shelamim! tena shelamim habbain mechamat pesach, utena shelamim habbain mechamat atzman. salka datach amena: hoil umechamat pesach kaatu,
b: Kefesach damu — ka mashma lan.
Menahane mille? detanu rabbanan: "ki tiddor neder", en li ella neder. nedava minnayin?
Neemar kan "neder", veneemar lehallan "im neder o nedava". ma lehallan — nedava immo, af kan — nedava immo.
"LaAdonai elohecha" — ellu haddamin haarachin vehacharamin vehahekdeshot. "lo teacher leshallemo" — hu velo chillufav. "ki darosh yidreshennu" — ellu chattaot vaashamot olot ushelamim.
"Adonai elohecha" — ellu tzedakot umaasrot uvechor. "meimmach" — ze leket shichcha ufea. "vehaya vecha chet" — velo bekorbancha chet.
Amar mar: "lo teacher leshallemo" — hu velo chillufav. chillufe may? i chillufe ola ushelamim — mikrav karvi.
I chillufe chattat, lemita azla. ella may chillufav — chillufe toda.
Detane rabbi chiyyay: toda shennitarva bitmuratah, umeta achat mehen — chavertah en lah takkana.
Hechi lebed? laykreva velaykrev lechem bahada — dilma temura hi. laykreva bela lechem — dilma toda hi.
Veha kevan delav bat hakerava hi, kera lemaote lema li?

Amar rav sheshet: leolam lemaote chillufe ola ushelamim, vehacha bemay askinan? kegon sheavru alav shene regalim vehumam, vechillelo al acher, veavar alav regel echad. salka datach amena: hoil umikkoach kamma kaate — keman deavru alav shelosha regalim dame, ka mashma lan.

Ulerabbi meir deamar: kevan sheavar alav regel echad over beval teacher", may ikka lememar? amar rava: hacha bemay askinan, kegon shehumam betoch haregel, vechillelo, veavar alav haregel. salka datach amena: hoil umikkoach kamma kaate — keman deavar aleh kulleh regel dame, ka mashma lan.
"Vehaya becha chet", velo bekorbancha chet. veha mehacha nafka? middaacherim nafka, detanya, acherim omrim: yachol yehe bechor sheavra shenato kifsule hammukedashin, veyippasel —

Talmud lomar: "veachalta lifne Adonai elohecha masar degancha tiroshcha veyitzharecha uvechorot bekarcha vetzonecha", makkish bechor lemaaser: ma maaser eno nifsal mishshana lachavertah, af bechor eno nifsal mishshana lachavertah.
Itzterich, salka datach amena: hane mille bechor, delav bar haretzaa hu, aval kodashim, divne haretzaa ninhu — ema la liratztzo, ka mashma lan.
Veakkatti,

a: Middeven azzay nafka, detanya: ben azzay omer: "oto"
Ma talmud lomar? lefi shenneemar: "lo teacher leshallemo", shomea ani af meacher nidro beval yeratze", talmud lomar: "oto" — oto belo yeratze", veen meacher nidro belo yeratze",
Ella: "becha chet" — velo beishtecha chet.

Salka datach amena: hoil veamar rabbi yochanan, vei tema rabbi elazar: en ishto shel adam meta ella im ken mevakkeshin mimmennu mamon veen lo, shenneemar: "im en lecha leshallem lamma yikkach mishkavcha mittachtecha", ema behay avon deval teacher" name ishto meta, ka mashma lan.

Tanu rabbanan: "motza sefatecha" — zo mitzvat ase, "tishmor" — zo mitzvat lo taase, "veasita" — azhara levet din sheyyeassuch, "kaasher nadarta" — ze neder, "laAdonai elohecha" — ellu chattaot vaashamot olot ushelamim, "nedava" — kemashmao, "asher dibbarta" — ellu kodshe bedek habbayit, "befich" — zo tzedaka.
Amar mar: "motza sefatecha" — zo mitzvat ase. lema li? miuvata shamma ... vahavetem shamma" nafka! "tishmor" — zo mitzvat lo taase. lema li? millo teacher leshallemo" nafka!

"Veasita" — azhara levet din sheyyeassuch. lema li? miyyakriv oto" nafka, detanya: "yakriv oto" — melammed shekkofin oto. yachol beal korcho — talmud lomar: "lirtzono", ha ketzad? kofin oto ad sheyyomar "rotze ani".
Chad, daamar vela afresh, vechad, afresh vela akrev.
Utzericha, dei ashmeinan amar vela afresh, mishshum dela kayyeymeh ledibbureh, aval afresh vela akrev, ema: kol hecha deiteh — be gazza derachamana iteh. tzericha.
Vei ashmeinan afresh vela akrev, deka mashhe leh gabbeh, aval amar vela afresh, ema dibbura lo kelum hu. tzericha.
Umi matzet amrat deamar vela afresh? veha nedava ketiva, utenan: e zehu neder — haomer: hare alay ola. vee zo hi nedava — haomer: hare zo ola.
Uma ben neder lindava? neder, met o nignav — chayyayv beachrayuto. nedava, meta o nigneva — eno chayyayv beachrayutah.
Amar rava: mashkachat la, kegon deamar: hare alay ola al menat sheeni chayyayv beachrayutah.
"Befich" — zo tzedaka. amar rava: utzedaka — michayyayv ala lealtar. may tama — deha kayymi aniyyim.
Peshita! mahu detema: kevan divinyayna dekorbanot ketiva, ad deavri ala shelosha regalim kekorbanot, ka mashma lan: hatam hu ditlinhu rachamana birgalim, aval hacha la — deha shechichi aniyyim.
Amar rava: kevan sheavar alav regel echad — over baase.

Metivi: heid rabbi yehoshua verabbi pappeyays al valad shelamim sheyyikrav shelamim. amar rabbi pappeyays: ani meid shehayta lanu para shel zivche shelamim vaachalnuha bappesach, veachalnu veladah shelamim bechag.
Bishlama befesach la akrevu, emor dimchussar zeman hava. ella valda baatzeret hechi mashhi le veavri aleh baase!
Amar rav zevid mishshemeh derava: kegon
b: Shehaya chole baatzeret. rav ashe amar: may "veachalnu veladah shelamim bechag" dekatane — chag hashshavuot.
Veiddach: kol hecha detane pesach, tane atzeret.

Amar rava: kevan sheavru alav shelosha regalim, bechol yom vayom over beval teacher". metivi: echad bechor, veechad kol hakkodashim, kevan sheavru alehem shana belo regalim, regalim belo shana — over beval teacher".
Vehay may teyuveteh? amar rav kahana: man deka motev — shappir ka motev: mikkede tanna allave ka mehaddar, litne: bechol yom vayom over beval teacher".
Veiddach — tanna lemikbeeh belav ka mehaddar, belave yeteri la ka mehaddar.

Gufa: echad bechor veechad kol hakkodashim, kevan sheavru alehem shana belo regalim, regalim belo shana — over beval teacher". bishlama regalim belo shana mashkachat la, ella shana belo regalim hechi mashkachat la?
Hanicha leman deit leh kesidran, mashkachat la. ella leman delet leh kesidran, hechi mashkachat la?
Bishlama lerabbi mashkachat la beshana meubberet. detanya: "shana temima", rabbi omer: mone shelosh meot veshishshim vachamishsha yom keminyan yemot hachamma,

Vachachamim omrim: mone shenem asar chodesh miyyom leyom, veim nitabbera shana — nitabbera lo. mashkachat la lerabbi deakdesha batar chag hammatztzot, dechi meta shilhe adar batraa — shana malya, regalim la melu. ella lerabbanan, hechi mashkachat la?
Kidtane rav shemaya: atzeret peamim chamishsha, peamim shishsha, peamim shiva. ha ketzad? shenehen melein — chamishsha, shenehen chaserin — shiva, echad male veechad chaser — shishsha.

Uman tanna diflig aleh derav shemaya — acherim hi. detanya, acherim omrim: en ben atzeret laatzeret, en ben rosh hashshana lerosh hashshana, ella arbaa yamim bilvad. veim hayta shana meubberet — chamishsha.
Bae rabbi zera: yoresh, mahu beval teacher"? "ki tiddor neder" amar rachamana, veha la nedar, o dilma: "uvata shamma vahavetem shamma", veha michayyayv.
Ta shema: detane rabbi chiyyay — "meimmach", perat leyoresh.
Vehay "meimmach" mibbee leh, ze leket shichcha ufea! keri beh "immach", ukeri beh "meimmach".
Bae rabbi zera: ishsha, ma hi beval teacher"? mi amrinan: ha la michayyeyva biriyya, o dilma ha ita besimcha?
Amar leh abbaye: vetippok leh deha ita besimcha. umi amar abbaye hachi? vehaamar abbaye: ishsha — baalah mesammechah! lidvarav derabbi zera kaamar.
Ibbaya lehu: bechor, meematay monin lo shana? abbaye amar: mishshaa shennolad, rav acha bar yaakov amar: mishshaa shennira leharetzaa.
Vela peligi: ha betam,

a: Ha bevaal mum.
Baal mum mi matze achel leh? dekim leh beh shekkalu lo chodashav.
Tanu rabbanan: beechad benisan rosh hashshana lochodashim, uleibburin, velitrumat shekalim. veyesh omrim: af lischirut battim.

Lochodashim menalan — dichtiv: "hachodesh hazze lachem rosh chodashim rishon hu lachem lechodshe hashshana. dabberu el kol adat yisrael lemor beasor lachodesh hazze veyikchu lahem ish se levet avot se labbayit. vehaya lachem lemishmeret ad arbaa asar yom lachodesh hazze veshachatu oto vegomer". uchetiv: "shamor et chodesh haaviv", ezehu chodesh sheyyesh bo aviv, heve omer — ze nisan, vekare leh rishon.
Veema iyyayr? baena aviv, velekka. veema adar? baena rov aviv, velekka. midde "rov aviv" ketiv?
Ella amar rav chisda, mehacha: "ach bachamishsha asar yom lachodesh hashshevii beospechem et tevuat haaretz", ezehu chodesh sheyyesh bo asifa, heve omer — ze tishri, veka kare leh "shevii".
Veema merachshevan, umay "shevii" — shevii leiyyayr? baena asif, velekka. veema elul, umay "shevii" — shevii laadar? baena rov asif, velekka. midde "rov asif" ketiv?

Ella amar ravina, davar ze mittorat moshe rabbenu lo lamadnu, middivre kabbala lamadnu: "beyom esrim vearbaa leashte asar chodesh hu chodesh shevat". rabba bar ulla amar mehacha: "vattillakach ester el hammelech achashverosh el bet malchuto bachodesh haasiri hu chodesh tevet".

Rav kahana amar mehacha: "bearbaa lachodesh hatteshii bechislev". rav acha bar yaakov amar mehacha: "vayyikkaru sofre hammelech baet hahi bachodesh hashshelishi hu chodesh sivan". rav ashe amar mehacha: "hippil pur hu haggoral lifne haman miyyom leyom umechodesh lechodesh shenem asar hu chodesh adar". veibbaet ema, mehacha: "bachodesh harishon hu chodesh nisan".
Vechullehu, may tama la amri mehay? dilma may "rishon" — rishon lemilleteh.
Vetanna didan — beshanim kamayyre, bochodashim la kamayyre.

Uleibburin leibburin minnisan maninan? vehatanya: en meabberin hashshana lifne rosh hashshana, veim ibberuha — enah meubberet. aval mippene haddechak — meabberin otah achar rosh hashshana miyyad. veaf al pi ken, en meabberin ella adar.
Amar rav nachman bar yitzchak: may ibburin — hafesakat ibburin. ditnan: hen heidu shemmeabberin hashshana kol adar. shehayu omrim — ad happurim.
May tama deman deamar ad happurim? kevan deamar mar: shoalin behilchot happesach kodem lappesach sheloshim yom, ate lezalzole bechametz.
Veiddach — midda yedia deshatta meabbarta bechushebana talya milleta, vesavri: chushebana hu dela selek lehu lerabbanan ad haiddana.
Vetanna didan? behatechala kamayyre, behafesaka la kamayyre.

Velitrumat shekalim. menalan? amar rabbi yoshiyya, amar kera: "zot olat chodesh bechodsho lechodshe hashshana" — amra tora: chaddesh vehave korban mitteruma chadasha. vegamri "shana" "shana" minnisan, dichtiv: "rishon hu lachem lechodshe hashshana".

Veligmor "shana" "shana" mittishri, dichtiv: "mereshit hashshana"! danin shana sheyyesh immah chodashim mishshana sheyyesh immah chodashim, veen danin shana sheyyesh immah chodashim mishshana sheen immah chodashim.
Amar rav yehuda amar shemuel: korbenot tzibbur habbain beechad benisan — mitzva lehavi min hechadash. veim hevi min hayyashan — yatza, ella shechisser mitzva.

Tanya name hachi: korbenot tzibbur habbain beechad benisan — mitzva lehavi min hechadash, veim hevi min hayyashan — yatza, ella shechisser mitzva. veyachid shehitnaddev mishshello — kesherin, bilvad sheyyimserem latztzibbur.
Peshita! mahu detema: lechush shemma
b: Lo yimserem latztzibbur yafe yafe, ka mashma lan.
Vetanna didan? kevan dekatane: im hevi yatza — la pesika leh.

Veyesh omrim: af lischirut battim. tanu rabbanan: hammaskir bayit lachavero leshana — mone shenem asar chodesh miyyom leyom. veim amar "leshana zo", afillu lo amad ella beechad baadar, kevan shehiggia yom echad benisan — alta lo shana.
Vaafillu leman deamar yom echad bashshana chashuv shana — shane hacha, dela tarach inish lemegar beta livtzir mittelatin yomin.
Veema tishri? setam ki agar inish beta — lechullehu yemot haggeshamim agar.
Vetanna kamma devarayyta, vetanna didan? benisan name mishkach shechichi kitre.
Beechad beelul rosh hashshana lemasar behema. manni — rabbi meir hi. detanya, rabbi meir omer: beechad beelul rosh hashshana lemasar behema.
Velargalim. manni — rabbi shimon hi. ema sefa, rabbi elazar verabbi shimon omrim: beechad betishri. resha vesefa rabbi shimon, umetziata rabbi meir!
Amar rav yosef: rabbi hi, venasev la allibba detannae. birgalim savar la kerabbi shimon, uvemasar behema savar la kerabbi meir.
I hachi, arbaa? chamishsha havu! amar rava: arbaa ledivre hakkol; lerabbi meir arbaa — dal regalim, lerabbi shimon arbaa — dal masar behema.
Rav nachman bar yitzchak amar: arbaa chodashim uvahen kamma rashe shanim.
Metivi: shishsha asar benisan — rosh hashshana laomer. shishsha besivan — rosh hashshana lishte hallechem. lerava litne shishsha, lerav nachman bar yitzchak litne chamishsha?
Amar rav pappa: ki ka chashev — midde dechayel meureta. midde dela chayel meureta — la ka chashev.
Vahare regalim, dela chayyli meureta, vekachashev! kevan shetztzarich leetoye meikkara, michayyayv vekae.
Vahare yovlot, dela chayyli meureta, vekachashev! rabbi yishmael beno shel rabbi yochanan ben beroka hi, deamar: merosh hashshana chayel yovel.
Rav shisha bereh derav idi amar: ki ka chashev — midde dela tele bemaase, midde ditle bemaase — la ka chashev.
Vahare regalim, midde ditle bemaase, veka chashev! "bal teacher" mimmela chayel.

a: Vahare yovlot! rabbi yishmael beno shel rabbi yochanan ben beroka hi.
Verav ashe amar: arba rashe hashshanim hem shehen bearba rashe chodashim.
Beechad bishvat — kevet shammay? hachi kaamar: shelosha ledivre hakkol, beechad bishvat — machloket bet shammay uvet hillel.

Rabbi elazar verabbi shimon omrim beechad betishri. amar rabbi yochanan: ushenehem mikra echad darshu, shenneemar: "lavshu charim hatztzon vaamakim yaatfu var yitroau af yashiru". rabbi meir savar: ematay lavshu charim hatztzon — bizman sheamakim yaatfu var. veematay amakim yaatfu var — baadar, mitabberot baadar veyoldot beav, rosh hashshana shellahen elul.

Rabbi elazar verabbi shimon omrim: ematay "lavshu charim hatztzon" — bizman sheyyitroau af yashiru", ematay shibbolim omrot shira — benisan, mitabberot benisan veyoldot beelul, rosh hashshana shellahen tishre.
Veiddach name, ha ketiv: "yitroau af yashiru"! hahu beaflata, dehavyayn benisan. veiddach name, hachtiv: "vaamakim yaatfu var"! hahu becharafyayta, deatyayn meadar.

Bishlama lerabbi meir, kedichtiv: "lavshu charim hatztzon" — bizman sheamakim yaatfu var", veikka name "yitroau af yashiru". ella lerabbi elazar verabbi shimon, ippecha mibbee leh: "lavshu charim hatztzon" — bizman sheyyitroau af yashiru", veikka name daamakim yaatfu var".

Ella amar rava: dechulle alma "lavshu charim hatztzon" — bizman sheamakim yaatfu var" baadar, vehacha behay kera kamippalgi: "asser teasser" — bishne maasrot hakkatuv medabber: echad masar behema veechad maaser dagan.

Rabbi meir savar: makkish masar behema lemaaser dagan: ma maaser dagan — samuch ligmaro issuro, af masar behema — samuch ligmaro issuro. verabbi elazar verabbi shimon savri: makkish masar behema lemaaser dagan: ma maaser dagan rosh hashshana shello tishri — af masar behema rosh hashshana shello tishri.
Beechad betishri rosh hashshana lashshanim. lemay hilcheta? amar rav pappa: lishtarot. ditnan: shitre chov hammukedamin — pesulin, vehameucharin — kesherin.
Vehatnan: beechad benisan rosh hashshana lammelachim, veamrinan: lemay hilcheta — veamar rav chisda lishtarot.
La kashya: kan lemalche yisrael, kan lemalche ummot haolam.
Ella ha deamar rav chisda: lo shanu ella lemalche yisrael, aval lemalche ummot haolam mittishri maninan — rav chisda matnitin ata leashmoinan?!
La, rav chisda kerae ata leashmoinan.
Veibbaet ema: rav chisda kerabbi zera matne la. derabbi zera amar: lattekufa, verabbi eliezer hi, deamar betishri nivra haolam.
Rav nachman bar yitzchak amar: laddin, dichtiv: "mereshit hashshana vead acharit shana", mereshit hashshana niddon ma yehe besofah.
Mimmay detishri hu? dichtiv: "tiku vachodesh shofar bakkese leyom chaggenu", ezehu chag
b: Shehachodesh mitkasse bo — heve omer ze rosh hashshana. uchetiv: "ki chok leyisrael hu mishpat lelohe yaakov".
Tanu rabbanan: "ki chok leyisrael hu mishpat lelohe yaakov" — melammed sheen bet din shel mala nichnasin laddin ella im ken kiddeshu bet din shel matta et hachodesh.

Tanya iddach: "ki chok leyisrael hu" — en li ella leyisrael, leummot haolam minnayin? talmud lomar: "mishpat lelohe yaakov". im ken, ma talmud lomar: "ki chok leyisrael", melammed sheyyisrael nichnasin techilla laddin.
Kidrav chisda. deamar rav chisda: melech vetzibbur — melech nichnas techilla laddin, shenneemar: "mishpat avdo umishpat ammo".
May tama? i baet ema: lav orach ara lemekam malka abbaray, veibbaet ema: mikkamme delipposh charon af.
Velashshemittin. menalan? dichtiv: "uvashshana hashsheviit shabbat shabbaton yihye laaretz", vegamar "shana" "shana" mittishri, dichtiv: "mereshit hashshana".

Veligmor "shana" "shana" minnisan, dichtiv: "rishon hu lachem lechodshe hashshana"! danin shana sheen immah chodashim mishshana sheen immah chodashim, veen danin shana sheen immah chodashim mishshana sheyyesh immah chodashim.
Velayyovlot. yovlot beechad betishri hu? yovlot baasara betishri hu, dichtiv: "beyom hakkippurim taaviru shofar"!

Ha manni — rabbi yishmael beno shel rabbi yochanan ben beroka hi. detanya: "vekiddashtem et shenat hachamishshim shana", ma talmud lomar? lefi shenneemar "beyom hakkippurim" — yachol lo tehe mitkaddeshet ella miyyom hakkippurim veelach, talmud lomar: "vekiddashtem et shenat hachamishshim", melammed shemmitkaddeshet veholechet mittechillatah.

Mikkan amar rabbi yishmael beno shel rabbi yochanan ben beroka: merosh hashshana ad yom hakkippurim lo hayu avadim niftarin levattehen, velo mishtabedin laadonehem — ella ochlin veshotin usemechin, veatrotehen berashehen. kevan shehiggia yom hakkippurim, taku bet din beshofar, nifteru avadim levattehen vesadot chozrot levalehen.
Verabbanan — shanim atta mekaddesh, vei atta mekaddesh chodashim.

Tanya iddach: "yovel hi" — ma talmud lomar? lefi shenneemar: "vekiddashtem et shenat hachamishshim", yachol keshem shemmitkaddeshet veholechet mittechillatah, kach mitkaddeshet veholechet besofah. veal titma, shehare mosifin mechol al kodesh — talmud lomar: "yovel hi shenat hachamishshim" — shenat hachamishshim atta mekaddesh, vei atta mekaddesh shenat hachamishshim veachat.

a: Verabbanan? shenat chamishshim atta mone, vei atta mone shenat chamishshim veachat — leappoke midderabbi yehuda, deamar: shenat chamishshim ola lechan ulechan, ka mashma lan dela.
Udemosifin mechol al kodesh menalan?

Detanya: "becharish uvakkatzir tishbot", rabbi akiva omer: eno tzarich lomar charish vekatzir shel sheviit, shehare kevar neemar "sadcha lo tizra vegomer". ella charish shel erev sheviit hannichnas lishviit, vekatzir shel sheviit hayyotze lemotzae sheviit.
Rabbi yishmael omer: ma charish reshut — af katzir reshut, yatza ketzir haomer shehu mitzva.

Verabbi yishmael mosifin mechol al kodesh mena leh? nafka leh middetanya: "veinnitem et nafshotechem betisha". yachol betisha? talmud lomar: "baerev", i "baerev" yachol mishshettechshach? talmud lomar: "betisha". ha ketzad? matchil umitanne mibbeod yom — melammed shemmosifin mechol al kodesh.
En li ella bichnisato, bitziato minnayin? talmud lomar: "meerev ad erev".
En li ella yom hakkippurim, shabbatot minnayin — talmud lomar: "tishbetu". yamim tovim minnayin? talmud lomar: "shabbattechem". ha ketzad? kol makom sheyyesh bo shevut — mosifin mechol al kodesh.

Verabbi akiva, hay "veinnitem et nafshotechem betisha" may aved leh! mibbee leh lechidtane chiyyay bar rav middifti. detane chiyyay bar rav middifti: "veinnitem et nafshotechem betisha" vechi betisha mitannin? vahalo baasiri mitannin! ella lomar lecha: kol haochel veshote bitshii, maale alav hakkatuv
b: Keillu hitanna teshii vaasiri.
Tanu rabbanan: "yovel hi" — af al pi shello shamtu, af al pi shello taku. yachol af al pi shello shillechu — talmud lomar: "hi", divre rabbi yehuda.
Rabbi yose omer: "yovel hi" — af al pi shello shamtu, af al pi shello shillechu. yachol af al pi shello taku — talmud lomar: "hi".

Vechi meachar shemmikra echad merabbe, umikra echad memaet, mippene ma ani omer: "yovel hi" — af al pi shello shillechu, veen yovel ella im ken taku? lefi sheefshar laolam belo shilluach avadim, vei efshar laolam belo tekiat shofar.
Davar acher: zo mesura levet din, vezo enah mesura levet din.
May "davar acher"? vechi tema: i efshar delekka chad besof haolam dela meshallach — zo mesura levet din, vezo enah mesura levet din.
Bishlama lerabbi yose — kidkaamar tameh, ella lerabbi yehuda — may tama? amar kera: "ukeratem deror baaretz", vekasavar: mikra nidrash lefanav, velo lifne fanav.
Dechulle alma — "deror" leshon cherut, may mashma? detanya: en "deror" ella leshon cherut. amar rabbi yehuda: ma leshon deror — kimdayyayr be dayyayra, umovil sechora bechol medina.
Amar rabbi chiyyay bar abba amar rabbi yochanan: zo divre rabbi yehuda verabbi yose. aval chachamim omrim: shelashtan meakkevot bo. kasavri: mikra nidrash lefanav, velifne fanav, uleacharav.
Vehachtiv: "yovel"! hahu, daafillu bechutza laaretz. vehachtiv: "baaretz"! hahu, bizman shennoheg deror baaretz — noheg bechutza laaretz, bizman sheeno noheg baaretz — eno noheg bechutza laaretz.
Velintia. menalan? dichtiv: "shalosh shanim arelim", uchetiv: "uvashshana harviit", veyalef "shana" "shana" mittishri, dichtiv: "mereshit hashshana":

Veligmar "shana" "shana" minnisan, dichtiv: "rishon hu lachem lechodshe hashshana"?! danin shana sheen immah chodashim mishshana sheen immah chodashim, veen danin shana sheen immah chodashim mishshana sheyyesh immah chodashim.

Tanu rabbanan: echad hannotea echad hammavrich, veechad hammarkiv erev sheviit, sheloshim yom lifne rosh hashshana — alta lo shana, umuttar lekayyeyman bashsheviit. pachot mishsheloshim yom lifne rosh hashshana — lo alta lo shana, veasur lekayyeyman bashsheviit.

a: Uferot netia zo asurin ad chamishsha asar bishvat, im leorla — orla, veim lirvai — revai.
Mena hane mille? amar rabbi chiyyay bar abba amar rabbi yochanan, umatu bah mishshemeh derabbi yannay, amar kera: "uvashshana harviit uvashshana hachamishit".
Peamim shebbarviit vaadayin asura mishshum orla, ufeamim shebbachamishit vaadayin asura mishshum revai.
Lema dela kerabbi meir, dei rabbi meir — ha amar: yom echad bashshana chashuv shana. detanya: par haamur battora setam — ben esrim vearbaa chodesh veyom echad. divre rabbi meir.
Rabbi elazar omer: ben esrim vearbaa chodesh usheloshim yom. shehaya rabbi meir omer: kol makom shenneemar egel battora setam — ben shana, "ben bakar" — ben shetayim, "par" — ben shalosh.
Afillu tema rabbi meir, ki kaamar rabbi meir yom echad bashshana chashuv shana — besof shana, aval bitchillat shana — la.
Amar rava: velav kal vachomer hu? uma nidda, sheen techillat hayyom ola lah besofah — sof hayyom ole lah bitchillatah. shana, sheyyom echad ole lah besofah —
b: Eno din sheyyom echad ole bitchillatah?

Veella may — rabbi elazar? sheloshim usheloshim bae! ditnan: en notin veen mavrichin veen markivin erev sheviit pachot mishsheloshim yom lifne rosh hashshana, veim nata vehivrich vehirkiv — yaakor, divre rabbi elazar. rabbi yehuda omer: kol harekava sheenah koletet bishlosha yamim — shuv enah koletet. rabbi yose verabbi shimon omrim: shete shabbatot.

Veamar rav nachman amar rabba bar avu: ledivre haomer sheloshim — tzarich sheloshim usheloshim, ledivre haomer shelosha — tzarich shelosha usheloshim, ledivre haomer shete shabbatot — tzarich shete shabbatot usheloshim yom. vei name, kerabbi yehuda sevira leh — shelosha usheloshim bae!
Ella leolam rabbi meir, vechi kaamar sheloshim — liklita.
I hachi, sheloshim veechad bae! ka savar: yom sheloshim ole lechan ulechan.

Amar rabbi yochanan, ushenehen mikra echad darshu: "vayhi beachat veshesh meot shana barishon beechad lechodesh", rabbi meir savar: middeakkatti yom echad hu deayel bashshana veka kare la shana, shema minna: yom echad bashshana chashuv shana.
Veiddach: i ketiv beshesh meot veachat shana" — kidkaamrat. hasheta dichtiv "beachat veshesh meot shana", "shana" ashshesh meot" kae. umay "achat" — atchalta deachat kaamar.

Verabbi elazar may tama? dichtiv: "barishon beechad lachodesh", middeakkatti yom echad hu deayel bachodesh veka kare leh chodesh — shema minna: yom echad bachodesh chashuv chodesh, umiddeyom echad bachodesh chashuv chodesh — sheloshim yom bashshana chashuvin shana. vechodesh limnuyav, veshana limnuyeha.
Mikkelal detarvayyhu sevira lehu benisan nivra haolam.

Tanya, rabbi eliezer omer: betishri nivra haolam, betishri noldu avot, betishri metu avot, bappesach nolad yitzchak, berosh hashshana nifkeda sara rachel vechanna, berosh hashshana yatza yosef mibbet haasurin.

a: Berosh hashshana batla avoda meavotenu bemitzrayim, benisan nigalu, betishri atidin liggael.

Rabbi yehoshua omer: benisan nivra haolam, benisan noldu avot, benisan metu avot, befesach nolad yitzchak, berosh hashshana nifkeda sara rachel vechanna, berosh hashshana yatza yosef mibbet haasurin, berosh hashshana batla avoda meavotenu bemitzrayim, benisan nigalu benisan atidin liggael.

Tanya, rabbi eliezer omer: minnayin shebbetishri nivra haolam — shenneemar: "vayyomer elohim tadshe haaretz deshe esev mazria zera etz peri". ezehu chodesh shehaaretz motzia deshaim veilan male perot — heve omer ze tishri. veoto happerek zeman revia hayta, veyardu geshamim vetzimmechu, shenneemar: "veed yaale min haaretz".

Rabbi yehoshua omer: minnayin shebbenisan nivra haolam — shenneemar: "vattotze haaretz deshe esev mazria zera veetz ose peri". ezehu chodesh shehaaretz melea deshaim veilan motzi perot — heve omer, ze nisan. veoto happerek, zeman behema vechayya vaof shemmizdavvevgin ze etzel ze, shenneemar: "lavshu charim hatztzon vegomer".
Veiddach name, ha ketiv: "etz ose peri"! hahu livracha ledorot hu dichtiv.

Veiddach name, ha ketiv: "etz peri"? hahu kidrabbi yehoshua ben levi. deamar rabbi yehoshua ben levi: kol maase vereshit lekomatan nivreu, ledatan nivreu, letzivyonan nivreu, shenneemar: "vaychullu hashshamayim vehaaretz vechol tzevaam", al tikre "tzevaam", ella "tzivyonam".
Rabbi eliezer omer: minnayin shebbetishri noldu avot — shenneemar: "vayyikkahalu el hammelech shelomo kol ish yisrael beyerach haetanim bechag", yerach shennoldu bo etane olam.

May mashma dehay "etan" lishshana detakkife hu — kedichtiv: "etan moshavecha", veomer: "shimu harim et riv Adonai vehaetanim mosde aretz", veomer: "kol dodi hinne ze ba medalleg al heharim mekappetz al haggevaot". "medalleg al heharim" — bizchut avot. "mekappetz al haggevaot" — bizchut immahot.

Rabbi yehoshua omer: minnayin shebbenisan noldu avot — shenneemar: "vayhi vishmonim shana vearba meot shana letzet bene yisrael meeretz mitzrayim bashshana harviit bechodesh ziv" — beyerach shennoldu bo zivtane olam.
Veiddach name, hachtiv: "beyerach haetanim"! hatam, detakkife bemitzvot.

Veiddach name, hachtiv: "bechodesh ziv"? hahu, deit beh ziva leilane. deamar rav yehuda: hay man dinfak beyome nisan vechaze ilane dimlavlevi, omer: baruch shello chisser meolamo kelum, uvara bo beriyyot tovot veilanot tovot lehitnaot bahen bene adam.

Man deamar benisan noldu — benisan metu. man deamar betishri noldu — betishri metu, shenneemar: "vayyomer alehem ben mea veesrim shana anochi hayyom", sheen talmud lomar "hayyom", uma talmud lomar "hayyom" — hayyom malu yamay ushenotay. lelammedcha shehakkadosh baruch hu yoshev umemalle shenotehem shel tzaddikim miyyom leyom mechodesh lechodesh, shenneemar: "et mispar yamecha amalle".

Befesach nolad yitzchak, menalan — kedichtiv: "lammoed ashuv elecha". emat kae? illema befesach vekaamar leh baatzeret — bechamshin yomin mi ka yalda? ella dekae baatzeret vekaamar leh betishri — akkatti bechamsha yarche mi ka yalda? ella dekae bechag vekaamar la benisan.
Akkatti, beshitta yarche mi ka yalda? tana: otah shana meubberet hayta. sof sof, ki madle mar yome tumea — batzri lehu!

Amar mar zutera: afillu leman deamar yoledet letisha — enah yoledet limkuttain, yoledet leshiva — yoledet limkuttain, shenneemar: "vayhi litkufot hayyamim", miut tekufot — shetayim, umiut yamim — shenayim.

Berosh hashshana nifkeda sara rachel vechanna. menalan? amar rabbi elazar: atya "pekida" "pekida", atya "zechira" "zechira". ketiv berachel: "vayyizkor elohim et rachel", uchetiv bechanna: "vayyizkereha Adonai", veatya "zechira" "zechira" merosh hashshana, dichtiv: "shabbaton zichron terua".
"Pekida" "pekida", ketiv bechanna: "ki fakad Adonai et channa", uchetiv besara: "vaAdonai pakad et sara".
Berosh hashshana yatza yosef mibbet haasurin, menalan — dichtiv: "tiku vachodesh shofar bakkese leyom chaggenu. ki chok leyisrael hu vegomer.
b: Edut bihosef samo betzeto vegomer".
Berosh hashshana batla avoda meavotenu bemitzrayim — ketiv hacha: "vehotzeti etchem mittachat sivlot mitzrayim", uchetiv hatam: "hasiroti missevel shichmo".
Benisan nigalu — kidita. betishri atidin liggael — atya "shofar" "shofar". ketiv hacha: "tiku vachodesh shofar", uchetiv hatam: "beyom hahu yittaka beshofar gadol".
Rabbi yehoshua omer: benisan nigalu, benisan atidin liggael — menalan? amar kera: "lel shimmurim" — layil hameshummar uva mishsheshet yeme bereshit.
Veiddach: layla hammeshummar uva min hammazzikin.

Veazdu letamayyhu, detanya: "bishnat shesh meot shana lechayye noach bachodesh hashsheni beshiva asar yom lachodesh", rabbi yehoshua omer: oto hayyom shiva asar beiyyayr haya, yom shemmazzal kima shokea bayyom umayanot mitmaatin. umittoch sheshshinnu maasehen, shinna hakkadosh baruch hu alehem maase vereshit, veheela mazzal kima bayyom, venatal shene kochavim mikkima vehevi mabbul laolam.
Rabbi eliezer omer: oto hayyom shiva asar bemarcheshvan haya, yom shemmazzal kima ole bayyom umayanot mitgabberim.

a: Umittoch sheshshinnu maasehem, shinna hakkadosh baruch hu alehem maase vereshit, veheela mazzal kima bayyom, venatal shene kochavim vehevi mabbul laolam.
Bishlama lerabbi yehoshua, hayeynu dichtiv: "sheni". ella lerabbi eliezer, may "sheni"? sheni ledin.
Bishlama lerabbi yehoshua, hayeynu deshinna. ella lerabbi eliezer, may shinna?

Kidrav chisda. deamar rav chisda: berotchin kilkelu uverotchin niddonu. berotchin kilkelu — baavera, uverotchin niddonu — ketiv hacha: "vayyashokku hammayim", uchetiv hatam: "vachamat hammelech shachacha".
Tanu rabbanan: chachme yisrael monin lammabbul kerabbi eliezer, velattekufa kerabbi yehoshua. chachme ummot haolam monin af lammabbul kerabbi yehoshua.
Velayyerakot. tana: layyerakot velammaasrot velannedarim. layyerakot may ninhu? maaser yarak.
Hayeynu maasrot? tena derabbanan vekatane deorayyta.
Velitne deorayyta beresha! ayyeyde dachaviva leh — akdema. vetanna didan? tena derabbanan, vechol shekken deorayyta.
Velitne "maaser"! echad masar behema veechad masar dagan. velitne "yarak"! tere gavvne yarak, ditnan: yarak hanneegad — mishsheyyeaged, vesheeno neegad — mishsheyyemalle et hakkeli.
Tanu rabbanan: likket yarak erev rosh hashshana ad shello tavo hashshemesh, vechazar velikket
b: Mishshettavo hashshemesh — en tormin umeasserin mizze al ze, lefi sheen tormin umeasserin, lo min hechadash al hayyashan, velo min hayyashan al hechadash. im hayta sheniyya nichneset lishlishit — sheniyya maaser rishon umaaser sheni, shelishit — maaser rishon umasar ani.

Mena hane mille? amar rabbi yehoshua ben levi: "ki techalle laser et kol masar tevuatcha bashshana hashshelishit shenat hammaaser", shana sheen bah ella maaser echad. ha ketzad? maaser rishon umasar ani, umaaser sheni yivtal.

O eno ella af maaser rishon name yivtal — talmud lomar: "veel haleviyyim tedabber veamarta alehem ki tikchu meet bene yisrael et hammaaser asher natatti lachem meittam benachalatchem", hikkisho hakkatuv lenachala: ma nachala en lah hefsek — af maaser rishon en lo hefsek.

Tanya iddach: "ki techalle laser vegomer", shana sheen bah ella maaser echad. ha ketzad? maaser rishon umasar ani, umaaser sheni yivtal. yachol af maaser rishon name yivtal? talmud lomar: "uva hallevi", kol zeman shebba — ten lo. divre rabbi yehuda.

Rabbi eliezer ben yaakov omer: eno tzarich, hare hu omer: "veel haleviyyim tedabber veamarta alehem ki tikchu meet bene yisrael et hammaaser asher natatti lachem meittam benachalatchem", hikkisho hakkatuv lenachala: ma nachala en lah hefsek — af maaser rishon en lo hefsek.

Velannedarim vechulei. tanu rabbanan: hammuddar hanaa mechavero leshana — mone shenem asar chodesh miyyom leyom. veim amar leshana zo, afillu lo amad ella beesrim vetisha beelul, kevan shehiggia yom echad betishri — alta lo shana.
Afillu leman deamar yom echad bashshana eno chashuv shana, letzaoreh nafsheh kabbel aleh — veha itztaar leh.
Veema nisan? bindarim hallech achar leshon bene adam.
Tenan hatam: hattiltan — mishshettitzmach, hattevua vehazzetim — mishsheyyaviu shelish.
May mishshettitzmach — mishshettitzmach lizraim.

Hattevua vehazzetim mishsheyyaviu shelish. mena hane mille? amar rav assi amar rabbi yochanan, umatu bah mishshemeh derabbi yose haggelili, amar kera: "mikketz sheva shanim bemoed shenat hashshemitta bechag hassukkot", shenat hashshemitta may avidteh bechag hassukkot? sheminit hi!
Ella, lomar lach: kol tevua shehevia shelish bashsheviit lifne rosh hashshana — atta noheg bo minhag sheviit bashsheminit.
Amar leh rabbi zera lerav assi:

a: Vedilma la ayel kelal, vekaamar rachamana teshammet vetezil ad chag hassukkot!
La salka datach, dichtiv: "vechag haasif betzet hashshana", may "asif"? illema: chag habba bizman asifa — hachtiv: "beospecha".
Ella may "asif" — katzir. vekim lehu lerabbanan dechol tevua shenniktzera bechag, beyadua shehevia shelish lifne rosh hashshana, veka kare la "betzet hashshana".
Amar leh rabbi yirmeya lerabbi zera: vekim lehu lerabbanan ben shelish lefachot mishshelish? amar leh: lav amena lach la tappek nafshach levar mehilcheta? kol middot chachamim — ken hu.
Arbaim sea hu tovel, bearbaim sea chaser kuretov — eno yachol litbol bahen. kevetza metamme tumeat ochalin, kevetza chaser shumeshum — eno metamme tumeat ochalin.
Shelosha al shelosha — mittamme midras, shelosha al shelosha chaser nima achat — eno mittamme midras.

Hadar amar rabbi yirmeya: lav milleta hi daamari. divo minneh chavrayyay merav kahana: omer shehikrivu yisrael bichnisatan laaretz, mehechan hikrivuhu? im tomar deayel beyad goy, "ketzirchem" amar rachamana — velo ketzir goy.

Mimmay deakrivu, dilma la akrivu! la salka datach, dichtiv: "vayyochlu meavur haaretz mimmochorat happesach". mimmochorat happesach — achul, meikkara — la achul. deakrivu omer vahadar achli. mehechan hikrivu?
Amar lahen: kol shello hevi shelish beyad goy.
Vedilma ayel vela kim lehu? ella kim lehu — hacha name kim lehu.
Vedilma la ayel kelal, aval hecha deayel riva — ben shelish lefachot mishshelish la kim lehu!
La salka datach, dichtiv: "vehaam alu min hayyarden beasor lachodesh", vei salka datach dela ayel kelal — bechamsha yome mi ka malya?
Ella may, deayel riva o danka? akkatti bechamsha yome mi ka malya! ella may it lach lememar: "eretz tzevi" ketiv ba — hacha name: "eretz tzevi" ketiv ba.
Matkef la rabbi chanina: umi matzet amrat dehay "asif" katzir hu? vehachtiv: "beospecha miggornecha umiyyikvecha", veamar mar: bifsolet goren veyekev hakkatuv medabber!
Amar rabbi zera: ha milleta havay bidan, vaata rabbi chanina sheda bay narga.
Ella menalan? kidtanya, rabbi yonatan ben yosef omer: "veasat et hattevua lishlosh hashshanim",
b: Al tikre "lishlosh", ella "lishlish".
Veha mibbee leh legufeh! ketiv kera acharina: "uzeratem et hashshana hashsheminit vaachaltem min hattevua yashan ad hashshana hatteshiit".
Tenan hatam: haorez vehaddochan vehapperagin vehashshumeshmin shehishrishu lifne rosh hashshana mitasserin lesheavar, umuttarin bashsheviit. veim lav — asurin bashsheviit, umitasserin leshana habbaa.
Amar rabba, amur rabbanan: ilan batar chanata, tevua vezetim batar shelish, yarak batar lekita. hane keman shavvinhu rabbanan?
Hadar amar rabba: mittoch sheasuyin perachin perachin, azli rabbanan batar hasherasha.
Amar leh abbaye: veyitzbor gorno letocho, venimtza torem min hechadash shebbo al hechadash shebbo, min hayyashan shebbo al hayyashan shebbo!

Mi la tanya, rabbi yose ben kippar amar mishshum rabbi shimon shezuri: pol hammitzri shezzerao lezera, miktzato hishrish lifne rosh hashshana, umiktzato hishrish leachar rosh hashshana — en tormin umeasserin mizze al ze, lefi sheen tormin umeasserin lo min hechadash al hayyashan velo min hayyashan al hechadash.
Ketzad hu ose — tzover gorno letocho, venimtza torem umeasser min hechadash shebbo al hechadash shebbo, umin hayyashan shebbo al hayyashan shebbo.
Amar leh: rabbi shimon shezuri kaamrat? rabbi shimon shezuri savar yesh billa.
Verabbanan savri en billa.

Amar rabbi yitzchak bar nachmani amar shemuel: halacha kerabbi yose ben kippar sheamar mishshum rabbi shimon shezuri. matkef la rabbi zera: umi amar shemuel hachi? vehaamar shemuel: lakkol en billa, chutz miyyayin vashemen!
Ishtemitteh ha deamar shemuel: hakkol holech achar gemar peri.

a: Utzericha: dei ashmeinan halacha kerabbi shimon shezuri, hava amena: mishshum dekasavar yesh billa, ka mashma lan: lakkol en billa.
Vei ashmeinan lakkol en billa — hava amena: kerabbanan sevira leh, ka mashma lan: halacha kerabbi shimon shezuri.
Vei ashmeinan hane tarte — hava amena: kashya dishmuel addishmuel, ka mashma lan: hakkol holech achar gemar peri.
Vei ashmeinan hakkol holech achar gemar peri — hava amena: afillu tevua vezetim name — ka mashma lan: halacha kerabbi shimon shezuri bemay diflig.
Velashmeinan hane tarte, lakkol en billa lema li? ha ka mashma lan, dilyayin vashemen yesh billa.

Tanya, rabbi yose haggelili omer: "beospecha miggornecha umiyyikvecha", ma goren vayekev meyuchadin sheggedelin al me shana sheavra, umitasserin leshana sheavra, af kol sheggedelin al me shana sheavra — mitasserin leshana sheavra. yatzu yerakot sheggedelin al me shana habbaa, umitasserin leshana habbaa.

Rabbi akiva omer: "beospecha miggornecha umiyyikvecha", ma goren veyekev meyuchadin sheggedelin al rov mayim, umitasserin leshana sheavra, af kol sheggedelin al rov mayim — mitasserin leshana sheavra. yatzu yerakot sheggedelin al kol mayim, umitasserin leshana habbaa.

May benayyhu? amar rabbi avahu: betzalim hassarisin ufol hammitzri ikka benayyhu. ditnan: betzalim hassarisin ufol hammitzri shemmana mehen mayim sheloshim yom lifne rosh hashshana — mitasserin lesheavar umuttarin bashsheviit, veim lav — asurin bashsheviit umitasserin leshana habbaa.
Beechad bishvat rosh hashshana lailan. may tama? amar rabbi elazar amar rabbi oshaya: hoil veyatzu rov gishme shana, vaadayin rov tekufa mibbachutz.
May kaamar? hachi kaamar: af al pi sherov tekufa mibbachutz, hoil veyatzu rov gishme shana.
Tanu rabbanan: maase berabbi akiva shellikket etrog beechad bishvat venahag bo shene issurin,
b: Echad kedivre bet shammay, veechad kedivre bet hillel.
Rabbi yose bar yehuda omer: lo minhag bet shammay uvet hillel nahag bah, ella minhag rabban gamliel verabbi eliezer nahag bah.

Ditnan: etrog shave lailan bishlosha derachim, velayyarak bederech echad. shave lailan bishlosha derachim: leorla velirvai velishviit uleyarak bederech echad — shebbishat lekitato issuro, divre rabban gamliel.
Rabbi eliezer omer: etrog shave lailan lechol davar.

Umi avdinan kitre chumere? vehatanya: leolam halacha kedivre bet hillel, veharotze laasot kedivre bet shammay — ose. kedivre bet hillel — ose. mikkulle bet shammay umikkulle bet hillel — rasha. mechumere bet shammay umechumere bet hillel — alav hakkatuv omer: "vehakkesil bachoshech holech". ella: i kevet shammay — bekullehon uvechumerehon. i kevet hillel — bekullehon uvechumerehon.
Rabbi akiva gemareh istappak leh, vela yeda i bet hillel beechad bishvat omer, i bachamishsha asar bishvat omer.
Rabbi yose bar yehuda omer: lo minhag bet shammay uvet hillel nahag bah, ella minhag rabban gamliel verabbi eliezer nahag bah. beechad bishvat — kevet shammay nahag bah!
Amar rabbi chanina veittema rabbi chananya: hacha beetrog shechantu perotav kodem chamishsha asar deiddach shevat askinan. uvedin hu afillu kodem lachen, umaase shehaya kach haya.
Ravina amar, keroch uteni: lo echad bishvat haya — ella chamishsha asar bishvat haya, velo minhag bet shammay uvet hillel nahag bah — ella minhag rabban gamliel verabbi eliezer nahag bah.
Amar rabba bar rav huna: hasheta deamar rabban gamliel etrog achar lekitato issuro keyarak, rosh hashshana shello tishri.

Metivi, rabbi shimon ben elazar omer: likket etrog erev chamishsha asar bishvat ad shello tavo hashshemesh, vechazar velikket mishshettavo hashshemesh — en tormin umeasserin mizze al ze, lefi sheen tormin umeasserin lo min hechadash al hayyashan velo min hayyashan al hechadash. hayta shelishit nichneset lirviit — shelishit maaser rishon umasar ani, reviit maaser rishon umaaser sheni.

a: Man shamat leh deazel batar lekita — rabban gamliel, vekatane shevat!
Ella, i ittemar hachi ittemar: amar rabba bar rav huna: af al gav deamar rabban gamliel etrog achar lekita keyarak — rosh hashshana shello shevat.
May shena hatam dekatane "im hayta sheniyya nichneset lishlishit" umay shena hacha dekatane "im hayta shelishit nichneset lirviit"?
Milleta aggav orcheh ka mashma lan, deetrog kashya leh yeda veayyeyde dimmashmeshi beh kulle alma bishviit, la taen pere ad telat shenin.
Bea minneh rabbi yochanan merabbi yannay: etrog, rosh hashshana shello ematay? amar leh: shevat. shevat dochodashim, o shevat ditkufa? amar leh: dochodashim.
Bea minneh rava merav nachman, veamri la rabbi yochanan merabbi yannay: hayta shana meubberet, mahu? amar leh: hallech achar rov shanim.
Amar rabba: etrog bat shishshit shennichnesa lishviit — petura min hammaaser ufetura min habbiur. uvat sheviit shennichnesa lishminit — petura bammaaser vechayyevet babbiur.
Amar leh abbaye: bishlama sefa — lechumera, ella resha petura min habbiur — ammay? deamrinan zil batar chanata, i hachi tichayyayv bemaaser!
Amar leh: yad hakkol memashmeshin bah, veat amrat tichayyayv bemaaser?!
Verav hamenuna amar: bat shishshit shennichneset lishviit — leolam shishshit, uvat sheviit hannichneset lishminit — leolam sheviit.

Metivi, rabbi shimon ben yehuda omer mishshum rabbi shimon: etrog bat shishshit shennichneset lishviit — petura min hammaaser ufetura min habbiur, sheen lecha davar shechayyayv bemaaser ella im ken gadal bechiyyuv venilkat bechiyyuv. uvat sheviit shennichneset lishminit — petura min hammaaser ufetura min habbiur, sheen lecha davar shechayyayv beviur ella im ken gadal bishviit venilkat bishviit.
Resha kashya lerav hamenuna, sefa kashya ben lerabba ben lerav hamenuna!
Tannae hi. detanya, amar rabbi yose, avtulemos heid mishshum chamishsha zekenim: etrog — achar lekitato lemaaser, verabbotenu nimnu beusha, veamru: achar lekitato, ben lemaaser ben lishviit.
Sheviit man dechar shemeh?
b: Chassore michassera vehachi katane: etrog — achar lekitato lemaaser veachar chanata lishviit. verabbotenu nimnu beusha: achar lekitato, ben lemaaser ben lishviit.

Ittemar, rabbi yochanan veresh lakish amri tarvayyhu: etrog bat shishshit shennichnesa lishviit — leolam shishshit. ki ata ravin amar rabbi yochanan: etrog bat shishshit shennichnesa lishviit, afillu kezayit venaaset kikkar — chayyayvin aleha mishshum tevel.

Tanu rabbanan: ilan shechantu perotav kodem chamishsha asar bishvat — mitasser leshana sheavra, achar chamishsha asar bishvat — mitasser leshana habbaa. amar rabbi nechemya: bamme devarim amurim — beilan sheose shete verichot bashshana.
Shete verichot salka datach? ella ema: keen shete verichot.
Aval ilan haose bericha achat, kegon dekalim vezetim vecharuvin, af al pi shechantu perotehen kodem chamishsha asar bishvat — mitasserin leshana habbaa.
Amar rabbi yochanan: nahagu haam becharuvin kerabbi nechemya.
Etiveh resh lakish lerabbi yochanan: benot shuach — sheviit shellahen sheniyya, mippene sheosot lishlosh hashshanim!
Ishtik. amar leh rabbi abba hakkohen lerabbi yose hakkohen: ammay ishtik? lema leh: amena lach ana rabbi nechemya, veat amrat li rabbanan?!
Mishshum daamar leh: shavkat rabbanan veavdat kerabbi nechemya?!
Velema leh: kaamena lach "nahagu", veat amrat li issura?! daamar leh: bimkom issura, ki nahagu shavkinan lehu?!
Velema leh: ki amena lach ana — maaser charuvin derabbanan, veat amrat li sheviit deorayyta?!
Ella amar rabbi abba hakkohen: temehani im heshivah resh lakish litshuva zo. im heshivah? ha otva! ella ema: im kibbelah rabbi yochanan, im la kibbelah.

a: Mishna bearbaa perakim haolam niddon: bappesach — al hattevua, baatzeret — al perot hailan, berosh hashshana — kol bae olam ovrin lefanav kivne maron, shenneemar: "hayyotzer yachad libbam hammevin el kol maasehem", uvechag niddonin al hammayim.
Gemara he tevua? illema ha tevua dekayyma, kol hane harepatke daado ala emat ittedun? ella tevua demizdara.

Lememra dechad dina mittadna? vehatanya: tevua sheera bah keri o ones, kodem happesach — niddonet lesheavar, leachar happesach — niddonet lehabba. adam sheera bo keri o ones, kodem yom hakkippurim — niddon lesheavar, leachar yom hakkippurim — niddon lehabba.
Amar rava: shema minna tere dine mittadna. amar abbaye: hilkach, ki chaze inash dematzlach zara afla — likaddem velizra charfa. dead demate lemedayyneh — kadem salek.
Manni matnitin? la rabbi meir, vela rabbi yehuda, vela rabbi yose, vela rabbi natan.

Detanya: hakkol niddonim barosh hashshana, ugezar din shellahem nechtam beyom hakkippurim, divre rabbi meir. rabbi yehuda omer: hakkol niddonin berosh hashshana, ugezar din shellahem nechtam kol echad veechad bizmanno: bappesach — al hattevua, baatzeret — al perot hailan, bechag niddonin al hammayim. veadam niddon berosh hashshana, ugezar din shello nechtam beyom hakkippurim.
Rabbi yose omer: adam niddon bechol yom, shenneemar: "vattifkedennu livkarim". rabbi natan omer: adam niddon bechol shaa, shenneemar: "lirgaim tivchanennu".
Vechi tema: leolam rabbi yehuda hi, vechi katane matnitin — aggezar din, i hachi — kashya adam!
