Amar rava: hay tana deve rabbi yishmael hi, detana deve rabbi yishmael, bearbaa perakim haolam niddon: bappesach — al hattevua, baatzeret — al perot hailan, bechag niddonin al hammayim. veadam niddon barosh hashshana, ugezar din shello nechtam beyom hakkippurim. vechi katane matnitin — attechillat din.
Amar rav chisda: may tama derabbi yose? kidkaamar tameh: "vattifkedennu livkarim"! anan hachi kaamrinan: may tama la amar kerabbi natan? bechina — ayyone bealma hi. pekida name ayyone bealma hi?!
Ella amar rav chisda: tameh derabbi yose mehacha: "laasot mishpat avdo umishpat ammo yisrael devar yom beyomo".

Veamar rav chisda: melech vetzibbur — melech nichnas techilla laddin, shenneemar: "laasot mishpat avdo umishpat ammo yisrael". may tama? ibbaet ema: lav orach ara lemetav malka abbaray. veibbaet ema: mikkamme delipposh charon af.

Amar rav yosef: keman metzallinan haiddana akketzire veammerie, keman — kerabbi yose. veibbaet ema: leolam kerabbanan, vechidrabbi yitzchak. deamar rabbi yitzchak: yafa tzeaka laadam ben kodem gezar din ben leachar gezar din.

Tanya, amar rabbi yehuda mishshum rabbi akiva: mippene ma amra tora haviu omer bappesach — mippene shehappesach zeman tevua hu, amar hakkadosh baruch hu: haviu lefanay omer bappesach, kede shettitbarech lachem tevua shebbassadot. umippene ma amra tora haviu shete hallechem baatzeret — mippene sheatzeret zeman perot hailan hu, amar hakkadosh baruch hu: haviu lefanay shete hallechem baatzeret, kede sheyyitbarchu lachem perot hailan.

Umippene ma amra tora nassechu mayim bechag — amar hakkadosh baruch hu: nassechu lefanay mayim bechag, kede sheyyitbarchu lachem gishme shana. veimru lefanay berosh hashshana malchiyyot zichronot veshofarot. malchiyyot — kede shettamlichuni alechem, zichronot — kede sheyyaale zichronychem lefanay letova, uvamme — beshofar.

Amar rabbi avahu: lama tokin beshofar shel ayil? amar hakkadosh baruch hu: tiku lefanay beshofar shel ayil, kede sheezkor lachem akedat yitzchak ben avraham, umaale ani alechem keillu akadtem atzmechem lefanay.
Veamar rabbi yitzchak: lamma tokin berosh hashshana? lamma tokin?! rachamana amar tiku! ella: lamma meriin? meriin?! rachamana amar "zichron terua"! ella: lamma tokin umeriin keshehen yoshvin,
b: Vetokin umeriin keshehen omdin — kede learbev hassatan.
Veamar rabbi yitzchak: kol shana sheen tokin lah bitchillatah — meriin lah besofah. may tama — dela iarbav satan.
Veamar rabbi yitzchak: kol shana sherasha bitchillatah — mitashsheret besofah, shenneemar: "mereshit hashshana" — "mereshit" ketiv. "vead acharit" — sofah sheyyesh lah acharit.
Veamar rabbi yitzchak: en danin et haadam ella lefi maasav shel otah shaa, shenneemar: "ki shama elohim el kol hannaar baasher hu sham".

Veamar rabbi yitzchak: shelosha devarim mazkirin avonotav shel adam, ellu hen: kir natuy, veiyyun tefilla, umoser din al chavero. deamar rabbi avin: kol hammoser din al chavero — hu neenash techilla, shenneemar: "vattomer saray el avram chamasi alecha", uchetiv: "vayyavo avraham lispod lesara velivkotah".

Veamar rabbi yitzchak: arbaa devarim mekarin gezar dino shel adam, ellu hen: tzedaka, tzeaka, shinnuy hashshem, veshinnuy maase. tzedaka, dichtiv: "utzedaka tatztzil mimmavet". tzeaka, dichtiv: "vayyitzaku el Adonai batztzar lahem umimmetzukotehem yotziem". shinnuy hashshem, dichtiv: "saray ishtecha lo tikra et shemah saray ki sara shemah", uchetiv: "uverachti otah vegam natatti mimmenna lecha ben". shinnuy maase, dichtiv: "vayyar haelohim et maasehem", uchetiv: "vayyinnachem haelohim al haraa asher dibber laasot lahem velo asa".
Veyesh omrim: af shinnuy makom, dichtiv: "vayyomer Adonai el avram lech lecha meartzecha", vahadar: "veeescha legoy gadol". veiddach: hahu zechuta deeretz yisrael hu deahanya leh.
Veamar rabbi yitzchak: chayyayv adam lehakebil pene rabbo baregel, shenneemar: "maddua at holechet elav hayyom lo chodesh velo shabbat", mikkelal divchodesh veshabbat ibbei la lemezal.
Veamar rabbi yitzchak: chayyayv adam letaher et atzmo baregel, shenneemar: "uvenivlatam lo tiggau".
Tanya name hachi: "uvinvalatam lo tiggau", yachol yehu yisrael muzeharin al magga nevela, talmud lomar: "emor el hakkohanim bene aharon", bene aharon muzeharin, bene yisrael en muzeharin.
Vahalo devarim kal vachomer: uma tumea chamura — kohanim muzeharin, yisreelim enan muzeharin. tumea kalla — lo kol shekken? ella, ma talmud lomar "uvenivlatam lo tiggau" — baregel.

Amar rabbi kerusepaday amar rabbi yochanan: shelosha sefarim niftachin berosh hashshana, echad shel reshaim gemurin, veechad shel tzaddikim gemurin, veechad shel benoniyyim. tzaddikim gemurin — nichtavin venechtamin lealtar lechayyim, reshaim gemurin — nichtavin venechtamin lealtar lemita, benoniyyim — teluyin veomdin merosh hashshana vead yom hakkippurim, zachu — nichtavin lechayyim, lo zachu — nichtavin lemita.

Amar rabbi avin, may kera: "yimmachu missefer chayyim veim tzaddikim al yikkatevu". "yimmachu missefer" — ze sifran shel reshaim gemurin, "chayyim" — ze sifran shel tzaddikim, "veim tzaddikim al yikkatevu" — ze sifran shel benoniyyim.

Rav nachman bar yitzchak amar, mehacha: "veim ayin mecheni na missifrecha asher katavta", "mecheni na" — ze sifran shel reshaim, "missifrecha" — ze sifran shel tzaddikim, "asher katavta" — ze sifran shel benoniyyim.

Tanya, bet shammay omrim: shalosh kittot hen leyom haddin: achat shel tzaddikim gemurin, veachat shel reshaim gemurin, veachat shel benoniyyim. tzaddikim gemurin — nichtavin venechtamin lealtar lechayye olam, reshaim gemurin — nichtavin venechtamin lealtar legehinnam, shenneemar: "verabbim miyyeshene admat afar yakitzu elle lechayye olam veelle lacharafot lediron olam", benoniyyim — yordin legehinnam,
